controls.description: Establish incident management framework and policy/procedures covering detection, monitoring, reporting, evaluation, prioritization, source/vulnerability identification, breach containment, damage evaluation, service restoration and post-incident monitoring.
controls.full_text: The bank shall establish an incident management framework and define an Incident Management Policy and procedures to protect, detect, evaluate and respond to cyber incidents. At minimum the procedures shall include following: Procedure for the detecting, monitoring and reporting of cyber incidents shall be defined. Tools for network monitoring, intrusion detection/prevention systems shall be configured to automatically alert and report suspicious events, both IT and non-IT incidents. Evaluation of a cyber incident shall be performed to assess if an incident is a false trigger or hoax, type and extent of the problem. Prioritization of the cyber incident, as per severity, and an action plan shall be prepared accordingly. Identification of the source of the problem, vulnerability that caused the incident or breach and containment of the breach, shall be documented. Evaluation of damage done if the breach has already occurred and estimation of rough schedule of recovery or control measures. Restoration of the services following resolution of the incident, and monitoring of the system for any further problems.
evidence_requirements: Incident playbooks covering all listed steps

controls.title: Dedicated incident handling resources with documented roles
controls.description: Identify dedicated resources to handle incidents; define and document roles/responsibilities for recording, analysing, remediating and monitoring incidents.
controls.full_text: The bank shall identify dedicated resources to handle incidents and roles/responsibilities of staff involved in the incident management process shall be defined and documented, which include recording, analyzing, remediating and monitoring incidents.

controls.title: Incident management program owner
controls.description: Appoint a person who owns and manages the incident management program including point of contact for security communications, budget, programme definition and execution.
controls.full_text: The bank shall appoint a person who owns and manages the incident management program, including point of contact for information security communications. The person shall be completely responsible for the functioning of the incident management program, including managing budget, defining the program and executing program.

controls.title: Adequate addressing and monitoring of incidents
controls.description: Address all incidents within corresponding resolution timeframes and monitor incidents per the framework.
controls.full_text: The incident management program shall adequately address all incidents within corresponding resolution timeframes and monitor all incidents as per the incident management framework.
evidence_requirements: Incident SLAs and resolution time tracking

controls.title: Severity classification and central response team
controls.description: Classify and prioritize incidents by criticality; corresponding escalation/resolution procedures with severity-commensurate timeframes; severity assignment delegated to centralized incident response team.
controls.full_text: Incidents shall be classified and prioritized according to criticality to ensure uniformity and optimum resource utilization. The bank shall establish corresponding escalation and resolution procedures where the resolution timeframe is commensurate with the severity level of the incident. The bank shall delegate the function of determining and assigning incident severity levels to a centralized incident response team.

controls.title: Root cause and impact analysis
controls.description: Perform root cause and impact analysis for major incidents covering timelines, revenue loss, costs, customers affected, reputation/confidence implications and corrective/preventive measures.
controls.full_text: The bank shall perform root cause and impact analysis and shall take measures to address major incidents which resulted in severe disruptions. Root cause analysis shall include timelines of incidents, revenue loss, costs, number of customers affected, implications and consequence to reputation and confidence, corrective and preventive measures.

controls.title: Evidence collection conforming to legal jurisdictions
controls.description: Collect, retain and present evidence related to incidents conforming to rules for evidence in relevant jurisdictions where follow-up action may involve legal action.
controls.full_text: Evidence related to incidents shall be collected, retained, and presented to conform to the rules for evidence laid down in the relevant jurisdiction(s) where follow up action against a person or organization involves legal action.

controls.title: Communication plan for internal/external incident reporting
controls.description: Define communication plan and procedure to report security incidents internally and externally (QCB, Ministry of Interior); include Public Relations/Communications in incident response.
controls.full_text: A communication plan and procedure to report information security incidents internally and externally (QCB and other agencies, such as the Ministry of Interior) shall be defined. The bank shall also include all relevant functions such as Public Relations or Communications in their incident response procedure and communication plan.

controls.title: Integration of incident management with awareness training
controls.description: Integrate incident management process with security awareness training; train users to report incidents and respond to certain incidents (fire, natural disasters).
controls.full_text: The incident management process shall be integrated with security awareness training. All users must be trained to report any incidents to the incident management team, and trained to respond to certain incidents (e.g. fire, natural disasters).
evidence_requirements: Awareness training modules on incident reporting

controls.title: 1-hour critical incident reporting to QCB and authorities
controls.description: All critical incidents must be reported to QCB and relevant governmental authorities within 1 hour of identification.
controls.full_text: All critical incidents must be reported to QCB and the relevant governmental authorities within 1 hour of identification.
evidence_requirements: Critical incident reporting procedure with 1-hour SLA

controls.title: Annual testing of incident response plan
controls.description: Test escalation and response plan annually simulating ransomware, extortion, DDoS and Level 1 severity incidents.
controls.full_text: The predetermined escalation and response plan for security incidents shall be tested on an annual basis to simulate how the organization responds to cyber-attacks, such as ransomware, extortion, DDoS and Level 1 severity incidents. These tests shall be carried to check the efficiency of the processes and the incident response plan.

controls.title: Documentation of lessons learned
controls.description: Compile and document all incident information; identify and evaluate lessons learned to improve incident handling process.
controls.full_text: All information regarding incidents shall be compiled and documented. Lessons learned during an incident shall be identified and evaluated to be used to improve incident handling process.

controls.title: Customer security awareness through notifications
controls.description: Raise customer security awareness through notifications, press releases, etc.
controls.full_text: The bank shall raise customers security awareness through notifications, press releases etc.

controls.title: Information sharing with QCB and MOI
controls.description: Keep QCB and MOI informed of any incident such as large-scale cyber incidents to enable proactive measures and minimise risk to the financial sector.
controls.full_text: The bank shall keep the QCB and MOI informed of any incident, such as large scale cyber incidents; where proactive measures can be initiated and the security risk to the financial sector can be minimized.

controls.title: ITIL framework consideration for IR
controls.description: Consider ITIL framework to enhance the incident management process.
controls.full_text: The bank shall consider an IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework to enhance the incident management process.
evidence_requirements: Mapping of IR process to ITIL incident management

controls.title: Patch management process
controls.description: Define patch management process with roles/responsibilities, methods of obtaining and validating patches, impact assessment, handling failed deployments; include vulnerability identification, business impact assessment of (non-)implementation, testing and deployment methods, and procedures for failed deployments (e.g. rollback, redeployment).
controls.full_text: The bank shall define a patch management process which includes roles and responsibilities, methods of obtaining and validating patches, assessing impact of patches and the process to deal with failed deployment of patches. At a minimum, the patch management process and procedure shall include: Methods of obtaining and validating patches to ensure that they are obtained from an authorized source. Identifying the vulnerabilities that are applicable to application and systems used by bank. Assessment of the business impact of implementation and non-implementation of the patches. Testing of the patches and methods of deployment of patches. Procedures and methods to deal with failed deployment of patches (for e.g. rollback, redeployment).

controls.title: Regular updates and patching of all products
controls.description: Ensure all products (OS, network/infrastructure devices, security software, remote access computers) are updated and patched regularly per the policy after due risk assessment in line with Change Management Policy.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that all products, such as operating systems, network and infrastructure devices, security software, and remote access computers are updated and patched regularly, in accordance with patch management policy/process. The upgrades and updates shall be performed after a due risk assessment and shall be in line with bank's Change Management Policy.
evidence_requirements: Patch compliance reports across asset classes

controls.title: Emergency patching for publicly reported vulnerabilities
controls.description: Continuously monitor vendor/OEM patch releases; have emergency patch management mechanism in place for protection against well-known/publicly reported vulnerabilities or attacks.
controls.full_text: The bank shall continuously monitor the release of the patches by vendors and OEMs. If the patches are released for protection against any well known, publicly reported vulnerability or attack, the bank shall have the mechanism in place to apply them expeditiously following an emergency patch management process.

controls.title: Critical patches tested before production
controls.description: Test critical patches in test environment before implementing in production; if patches break critical business apps on test machines, devise other mitigating controls to block exploitation.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that the critical patches are tested in a test environment before implementing in production systems. If such patches break critical business applications on test machines, the organization must devise other mitigating controls that block exploitation of the system.
evidence_requirements: Compensating control documents when patches fail

controls.title: Mitigation when no patch is available
controls.description: Establish methods to protect systems when no patch is available for identified vulnerability, e.g. disabling services, adding access controls.
controls.full_text: It must be ensured that appropriate methods are established to protect information systems if no patch is available for an identified vulnerability, for example disabling services, adding additional access controls.

controls.title: Measurement of patch delay against baseline
controls.description: Measure delay in patching new vulnerabilities and ensure delay is not beyond organisation's baseline.
controls.full_text: The bank shall measure delay in patching new vulnerabilities and ensure that the delay in patching is not beyond the baseline set by the organization.

controls.title: Logging and monitoring policy
controls.description: Define policy for logging and security monitoring including identification, continuous monitoring and logging of access, changes and modifications; define IT assets and processes to be monitored and logged.
controls.full_text: The bank shall define a policy for logging and security monitoring, which includes (a) identification (b) continuous monitoring and (c) logging of access, changes and modification to information systems. The process shall define the IT assets and processes that shall be monitored and logged.

controls.title: Continuous monitoring with clear responsibility
controls.description: Employ processes/technology for continuous monitoring of applications, network/infrastructure devices and servers with clear allocation of responsibilities for regular monitoring.
controls.full_text: The bank must employ suitable processes/technology for enabling continuous monitoring of information system assets, such as applications, network and infrastructure devices and servers. The process shall include a clear allocation of responsibilities for regular monitoring of the assets.

controls.title: Criticality-based monitoring with 4-eye principle
controls.description: Monitoring practices established based on criticality; 4 eye principle in place to monitor processes.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that monitoring practices are established based on the criticality of the information, processes and infrastructure, and 4 eye principle shall be in place to monitor processes.

controls.title: Logging enabled with integrity protection
controls.description: Enable logging on all infrastructure/data processing equipment and applications handling access/transmission/processing/security/storage of critical information; restrict log access to prevent modification/deletion; monitor log integrity continuously.
controls.full_text: Logging must be enabled on all infrastructure and data processing equipment, and applications that are associated with access, transmission, processing, security and storage of critical information. Access to the logs shall be restricted to prevent modification or deletion. Integrity of the logs shall be monitored continuously.

controls.title: 24x7 SOC onsite or in Qatar
controls.description: Establish and implement Security Operations Centre functioning 24x7 onsite or in Qatar for centralized and coordinated monitoring of cyber risks and management of security-related incidents.
controls.full_text: The bank shall establish and implement a Security Operations Centre (SOC) functioning 24x7 onsite or in Qatar, for the centralized and coordinated monitoring of cyber risks and management of security related incidents.
evidence_requirements: SOC operating model and location confirmation

controls.title: Audit trails of administrator activities reviewed on alert/incident
controls.description: Audit trails of daily activities of system administrators and elevated-privilege users shall be reviewed in case of an alert/incident.
controls.full_text: Audit trails of daily activities of users, such as system administrators and users with elevated privileges, shall be reviewed in case of an alert/ incident.

controls.title: 180-day log retention with automated and manual review
controls.description: Logs retained minimum 180 days with maximum depending on criticality and local laws; include date, time, command, IP, authentication; monitor via automated systems and SOC, with significant logs manually reviewed.
controls.full_text: The logs must be retained for a minimum of six months (180 days) and the maximum depending on criticality of the system/application and as per local laws and regulations. The logs shall include basic elements such as date, time, command executed, IP address and authentication information to ensure that adequate information is available to assist reconstruction of an incident, if required. The bank shall ensure that all logs must be monitored via automated systems and through SOC and logs with significant interest shall be reviewed manually.
evidence_requirements: Sample log entry with required fields
Manual review records of high-interest logs

controls.title: Semi-annual user access reviews
controls.description: Perform user access reviews on a semi-annual basis to disable or remove accounts no longer required or assigned.
controls.full_text: User access reviews shall be performed on a semi-annual basis to disable or remove accounts that are no longer required or assigned to any user.

controls.title: SIEM for collection, correlation and alerting
controls.description: Implement SIEM to collect, aggregate, correlate and analyse disparate data from various sources and alert on suspicious events.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement a Security Information Event Management (SIEM) system to collect, aggregate, correlate and perform analysis of disparate data from various sources and an alert in case suspicious events are detected.

controls.title: Enterprise log repository
controls.description: Implement enterprise log repository solutions for managing, aggregating and retaining logs efficiently.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement enterprise log repository solutions for managing, aggregating and retention of logs efficiently.

controls.title: MSSP integration if monitoring outsourced
controls.description: If monitoring/event management is outsourced to MSSP, obtain as much incident information as possible from MSSP and implement security measures suggested by them.
controls.full_text: If the bank has outsourced monitoring and event management services to a Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), the bank shall obtain as much information as possible on the incident from the MSSP and implement the security measures suggested by the provider.

controls.title: Privacy protection of logs containing personal information
controls.description: Logs containing personal information shall have appropriate privacy protection measures in line with the proposed information privacy and protection law.
controls.full_text: Logs containing personal information shall have the appropriate privacy protection measures in place and shall be in line with the proposed information privacy and protection law.

controls.title: Monitoring and logging aligned to regulatory/legal frameworks
controls.description: All monitoring and logging activities shall be in line with the various regulatory and legal frameworks.
controls.full_text: It must be ensured that all monitoring and logging activities are in line with the various regulatory and legal frameworks.

controls.title: Classification and access controls for security logs
controls.description: Security logs of systems and applications classified per criticality; access controls protect security logs from unauthorized access and tampering.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that security logs of the systems and applications are classified according to their criticality. Access controls should be defined to ensure that security logs are protected from unauthorized access and tampering.

controls.title: Monitoring integrated with incident handling
controls.description: System monitoring processes integrated with incident handling; exceptions recorded and acted upon per incident management process.
controls.full_text: System monitoring processes must be integrated with incident handling, exceptions observed should be recorded and acted upon as per the incident management process.

controls.title: Network surveillance with IDS/IPS
controls.description: Implement network surveillance and security monitoring using network security devices such as IDS/IPS to protect against network intrusion attacks.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement network surveillance and security monitoring with use of network security devices, such as intrusion detection and prevention systems to protect the bank against network intrusion attacks.

controls.title: Capacity management policy
controls.description: Define capacity management policy with thresholds, performance and precautionary measures including capacity plan covering current usage and future requirements, translating business needs to IT service & infra requirements, managing/controlling/predicting end-to-end live service performance/capacity, and identifying/understanding per-component performance/capacity/utilization.
controls.full_text: The bank shall define capacity management policy to set out guidelines for system utilization threshold, system performance and corresponding precautionary measures. The following key activities shall be included as part of capacity management, at a minimum: Capacity plan which depicts current level of resource utilization and service performance and for casting of future requirements. Guidelines for translating business needs into requirement for IT service and supporting infrastructure. Guidelines for management, control and prediction of end to end performance and capacity of live and operational IT service usage. Guidelines to identify and understand the performance, capacity and utilization of individual component within a technology used to support IT services.

controls.title: Continuous performance monitoring
controls.description: Process to ensure system performance is continuously monitored to determine if system meets/exceeds agreed performance targets.
controls.full_text: The bank shall define and implement a process to ensure that system performance is continuously monitored to determine if the system meets or exceeds the agreed performance targets.

controls.title: Capacity planning for sudden upsurge and incident diagnosis
controls.description: Capacity planning shall account for sudden transaction upsurge during particular timings/situations and support diagnosis of performance/capacity related incidents and problems.
controls.full_text: The capacity planning shall take into account the possibility of a sudden upsurge in transactions during particular timings or situations, and diagnosis of performance and capacity related incidents and problems.

controls.title: Change impact on capacity and performance
controls.description: Assess and determine change impact on systems based on effects on capacity planning and IT service performance.
controls.full_text: Impact of the changes on the systems shall be assessed and determined on the basis of its effects on capacity planning and performance of IT services.

controls.title: Continuous CPU, network, memory monitoring
controls.description: Implement tools/scripts on technology systems to continuously monitor and capture CPU, network and memory utilization, supporting upgrade and technology refresh forecasting.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement tools/scripts on technology systems to continuously monitor and capture the CPU, network and memory utilization. This will also be useful when casting for upgrades or technology refresh.

controls.title: Capacity planning for backup and DR
controls.description: Capacity planning extended to include backup systems and disaster recovery environment and facilities.
controls.full_text: Capacity planning shall be extended to include backup systems and disaster recovery environment and facilities.

controls.title: Problem management framework
controls.description: Implement problem management framework to minimize adverse impact of incidents by identifying root cause; logging known errors and communicating workarounds; finding permanent solutions and preventing recurrence; includes RCA, implementation via change/release mgmt, turnaround/resolution for unresolvable incidents, periodic trend analysis.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement a problem management framework to minimize the adverse impact of incidents on IT Infrastructure and business by identifying root cause; logging known errors and providing and communicating work around them; finding permanent solutions and preventing recurrence. The problem management process shall include following: Process to perform root cause analysis of an incident and determine resolution. Implementation of solution through change management and release management. Turnaround and resolution for incidents that cannot be resolved due to business case or technical short fall. Periodic trend analysis of the problem with respect to customer or system facing channels.

controls.title: Roles and SLAs for problem management
controls.description: Establish roles/responsibilities; identify, classify, prioritize and address all problems in timely manner within predefined service levels.
controls.full_text: The bank shall establish roles and responsibilities of staff involved in the problem management process. The bank must identify, classify, prioritize and address all problems in a timely manner and within predefined service levels.

controls.title: Helpdesk for front-line technology support
controls.description: Set up a helpdesk to provide front-line support on all technology problems and relay problems to relevant IT functions for investigation/resolution.
controls.full_text: A helpdesk shall be set up to provide front line support to users on all technology related problems and to relay the problem to the relevant IT functions for investigation and resolution.

controls.title: Root cause and recurrence prevention
controls.description: Problem management shall include activities for root cause identification, permanent solutions and preventing recurrence of incidents.
controls.full_text: Problem management shall include activities required to identify root cause, finding permanent solutions and preventing the recurrence of incidents.

controls.title: ITIL consideration for problem management
controls.description: Consider ITIL framework to enhance problem management process.
controls.full_text: The bank shall consider an ITIL framework to enhance the problem management process.

controls.title: Backup and archiving policy aligned with local regulations
controls.description: Define backup and archiving process including frequency, backup media details, access privileges and classification; aligned with local regulations.
controls.full_text: The bank shall define a process for data backup and archiving critical business information and shall include frequency of data backup and archiving, details of backup media, access privileges to backup and classification. The backup and archiving policy shall be in line with local regulations.

controls.title: Backup process and archival technologies and strategies
controls.description: Implement backup and archiving technologies enabling backup/retrieval of critical business info; strategies include backup on tape and sent offshore, backup made on disks copied to offsite disks or made directly to offsite disks, replication to offsite location, high-availability systems keeping data and system replicated offsite in real time.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement a backup process and archiving technologies to enable backup and retrieval of critical business information. The bank shall implement the following strategies for protection of data: Backup the data on tapes and sent offshore. Backup made on disks to be copied to offsite disks or made directly to offsite disks. Replication of data to an offsite location. High availability systems that keep both data and system replicated offsite at real time.

controls.title: Encryption of backup media in transit
controls.description: Encrypt backup tapes and disks containing sensitive information before transport to offsite storage.
controls.full_text: The bank shall encrypt backup tapes and disks containing sensitive information before they are transported to offsite storage.

controls.title: Semi-annual recovery validation
controls.description: Carry out semi-annual testing and validation of recovery capability of backup media; assess if backup media is adequate and effective to support recovery process.
controls.full_text: The bank shall carry out semi annual testing and validation of recovery capability of backup media, and assess if backup media is adequate and effective to support the bank's recovery process.

controls.title: Management-approved IT refresh policy
controls.description: Establish management-approved IT refresh policy considering standardization, refresh plan, cycles/timelines, hardware/software acquisition, decommission and disposal.
controls.full_text: The bank must establish an IT refresh policy and shall be approved by management. The policy must consider standardization; a refresh plan; cycles and timelines; hardware and software acquisition; decommission and disposal.

controls.title: Up-to-date software/hardware inventory for production and DR
controls.description: Maintain up-to-date inventory of software/hardware in production and DR including warranty/support contract information.
controls.full_text: The bank must maintain an up to date inventory list of software and hardware components used in production and the disaster recovery environment, which includes all relevant associate warranty and other support contract-related information.
evidence_requirements: CMDB / asset register with warranty & contract data

controls.title: Technology refresh plan and monitoring
controls.description: Establish technology refresh plan and actively monitor IT systems/software so outdated/unsupported systems increasing security exposure are replaced/upgraded timely.
controls.full_text: The bank shall establish a technology refresh plan and actively monitor its IT systems and software, so that outdated and unsupported systems which increase exposure to security risks are replaced and/or upgraded on timely basis.

controls.title: EOL/EOS tracking with risk-based mitigations
controls.description: Track and monitor product EOL/EOS dates; phase out or upgrade outdated devices; perform risk assessment of continued usage and establish mitigating controls when necessary.
controls.full_text: The bank must track and monitor a product's end of life (EOL) and end of support (EOS) dates, and phase out or upgrade the outdated devices. The bank shall also perform risk assessment of these systems to assess the risk of continued usage of the systems and establish mitigating controls where necessary.
evidence_requirements: Risk assessment for retained EOL systems

controls.title: Inventory of UAT/test/staging/store/stock
controls.description: Maintain inventory list of software and hardware components in UAT, test, staging, store and stock.
controls.full_text: The bank must maintain the inventory list of software and hardware components in UAT, test, staging, store and stock.

controls.title: Management-approved cloud computing policy
controls.description: Establish management-approved cloud computing policy covering applications/data to be hosted, potential risks, and cloud service provider infrastructure/process/operations risks; reviewed periodically.
controls.full_text: The bank must establish a cloud computing policy and should be approved by management. The policy must be further reviewed periodically. The policy should cover details on applications and data that will be hosted in cloud environments with their potential risks and risk of the cloud service providers infrastructure, process and operations.

controls.title: Cloud service provider agreement minimum coverage
controls.description: Agreement with CSP must cover at minimum: contract cancellation/modification fees, overhead costs, run-away costs from poor planning, data leakage (external/insider), unauthorized access by service provider, data leakage from shared infrastructure, lack of encryption, operations/security compliance monitoring, cloud migration plan, transition to second provider, service rollback plan, and notification of third-party/government access requests.
controls.full_text: The agreement with the cloud service provider shall cover at a minimum: (a) contract cancellation and modification fees, (b) additional overhead costs, (c) run-away costs from poor planning, (d) data leakage from malicious sources (,external or insider), (e) unauthorized data access by service provider, (f) data leakage due to shared infrastructure, (g) lack of encryption controls, (h) monitor for operations and security compliance, (i) cloud migration plan, (j) cloud transition to a second provider, (k) service roll back plan, (l) notification/alert mechanisms in place in the event of requests to access data by any other third parties or governments.

controls.title: Geography/jurisdiction risk factors
controls.description: Policy must consider risk factors of geography and jurisdiction where data hosted/backed up at the cloud service provider will physically reside.
controls.full_text: The policy must take into consideration, risk factors of which geography and jurisdiction the data hosted/backed up at the cloud service provider will physically reside.

controls.title: Periodic CSP security compliance reports
controls.description: Obtain periodic security compliance reports on VM instance/cloud service and overall security of cloud service provider.
controls.full_text: The bank must obtain periodic security compliance reports on the VM instance/cloud service and overall security of the cloud service provider.

controls.title: ISAE / assurance reports from CSP
controls.description: Obtain ISAE or assurance reports on security controls incorporated from a services organization perspective.
controls.full_text: The bank must obtain International Standard on Assurance Engagements (ISAE) or assurance reports on the security controls incorporated from a services organization perspective.

controls.title: Cloud risks remain bank's responsibility
controls.description: Use of cloud services not justification to delegate risk controls; consider data leakage, interception, intrusion/unauthorized access, cloud API risks, data integrity, service availability, legal risk.
controls.full_text: Use of cloud computing services shall not be used as justification to delegate the risk controls that surround the data/system that is deployed in the cloud. Several risks exist and shall be considered when accessing cloud services including: data leakage, data interception, intrusion/unauthorized access, cloud application interfaces risks, integrity of data and availability of cloud services or legal risk.

controls.title: Documented existence of key security domains pre-contracting
controls.description: Prior to contracting with cloud vendor obtain documentation evidence of: access controls, auditing, authentication, awareness/education, business continuity, configuration management, data security, incident management, maintenance/support, media protection, personnel security, physical security, planning, procurement, risk management, security assessment, system security and integrity controls.
controls.full_text: The bank must seek the existence of the following key security domains, via documentation evidence, prior to contracting with a cloud service vendor: access controls, auditing, authentication, awareness and education, business continuity, configuration management, data security, incident management, maintenance and support, media protection, personnel security, physical security, planning, procurement, risk management, security assessment, system security and integrity controls.
evidence_requirements: Pre-contract CSP due diligence covering all listed security domains

controls.title: Critical data not in non-controlled cloud
controls.description: Ensure critical data not stored in a non-controlled cloud environment; private cloud facility under control of the bank shall be considered as alternative.
controls.full_text: The bank must make sure critical data is not stored in a non-controlled cloud environment. Private cloud facility under control of the bank shall be considered as an alternative.
evidence_requirements: Data classification preventing critical data in non-controlled cloud

controls.title: Key security controls in cloud agreement
controls.description: When using cloud computing, agreement with CSP must contain key security controls limiting aforementioned risks.
controls.full_text: When using cloud computing, the bank must make sure that the agreement with the cloud computing service provider contains key security controls limiting the aforementioned risks.
evidence_requirements: Security controls schedule in cloud contract

controls.title: Cloud-specific due diligence attributes
controls.description: During due diligence consider attributes/risks specific to cloud service: sovereignty, platform multi-tenancy, recoverability, regulatory compliance, auditing and data offshoring.
controls.full_text: While performing due diligence for the cloud computing service provider, the bank shall consider attributes and risks specific to cloud service, such as sovereignty, platform multi-tenancy, recoverability, regulatory compliance, auditing and data offshoring.
evidence_requirements: Cloud due diligence checklist covering listed attributes

controls.title: Penetration test of VM image/infrastructure/application
controls.description: Have contractual power to conduct penetration test on VM image/infrastructure and application instance provided by cloud provider, if feasible.
controls.full_text: The bank shall have contractual power to conduct a penetration test on the Virtual Machine (VM) image/infrastructure and application instance provided to the bank by the cloud provider, if feasible.
evidence_requirements: Pentest right clauses in CSP contract

controls.title: Right to destroy data on termination/expiry
controls.description: Have contractual power and means to destroy data stored within service provider's systems and backups on contract termination or expiry.
controls.full_text: The bank must have the contractual power and the means to destroy data stored within the service provider's systems and backup, in event of contract termination or expiry.

controls.title: Penetration test and audit of cloud L3 switch
controls.description: Have contractual power to conduct penetration test and audit of cloud provider's Layer 3 switch connected to VM image/infrastructure and applications provided to the bank.
controls.full_text: The bank shall have contractual power to conduct a penetration test and audit of the cloud provider's Layer 3 (L3) switch connected to the VM image/infrastructure and applications provided to the bank.

controls.title: Verify CSP RTO before contracting
controls.description: Verify CSP's ability to recover outsourced systems and IT services within stipulated RTO prior to contracting.
controls.full_text: The bank shall verify the service provider's ability to recover the outsourced systems and IT services within the stipulated Recovery Time objective (RTO) prior to contracting with the service provider.

controls.title: Access controls policy and procedures
controls.description: Define access controls policy and relevant procedures including identification, authentication and authorization of users.
controls.full_text: The bank shall define the access controls policy and relevant procedures which shall include identification, authentication and authorization of users.

controls.title: RBAC, least privilege, need-to-know and need-to-have
controls.description: Policies based on RBAC and least privilege governed by need-to-know and need-to-have principles for logical access.
controls.full_text: The policies shall be based on the concepts of Role Based Access Controls (RBAC) and least privilege, and governed by the principles of 'need-to-know' and 'need-to-have' basis for logical access.

controls.title: Segregation of duties and 4-eye principle
controls.description: Use SoD to minimize conflict of interest; systems must allow application of 4-eye principle; segregate roles through user account privileges based on roles.
controls.full_text: The segregation of duties principle shall be used to minimize the conflict of interest. In the same manner, systems must allow application of the 4 eye principle. Segregating the roles through user account privileges based on roles is a key process in minimizing unauthorized access or change on bank systems or applications.

controls.title: Job rotation and cross training
controls.description: Implement job rotation and cross training to minimize risk of dependency and coercion to commit fraud.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement job rotation and cross training to minimize risk of dependency and coercion to commit fraud.

controls.title: Lost/stolen/compromised password handling
controls.description: Document and communicate processes for lost/stolen/compromised passwords; require users to change password after theft/compromise, notify infosec team and identify user before replacement.
controls.full_text: The bank shall document processes for dealing with lost, stolen or compromised passwords and users are made aware of the process. The policy shall require users to change the password after theft or compromise, notification to the information security team and identification of the user before replacement of the password.
evidence_requirements: User identification procedure prior to reset

controls.title: Periodic audit of accounts handling critical information
controls.description: Audit accounts processing critical information periodically to confirm they are current; confirm changes in status/roles (promotion, demotion, transfer, termination) reflected in system.
controls.full_text: Any accounts processing critical information must be audited periodically to ensure that they are current and up to date. The audit shall confirm that, in cases where an employee's status, roles and responsibilities have changed due to promotion, demotion, transfer, termination etc., these changes are reflected in the system.

controls.title: Access rights based on access control matrix
controls.description: Access rights to create/update/delete/transmit information based on access control matrix defined by business rules; matrix defined by owner of information/system.
controls.full_text: Access rights of users to create, update, delete or transmit information shall be based on access control matrix defined by business rules. The access control matrix shall be defined by the owner of the information or the system.

controls.title: Division of responsibilities for sensitive processes
controls.description: Implement division of responsibilities over sensitive security processes/tasks using least privilege and 4-eye principle to avoid single individual having full control over critical processes.
controls.full_text: The bank must implement a division of responsibilities over sensitive security processes and tasks, using principles of least privilege and 4 eye principle to ensure the avoidance of a single individual having full control over critical processes or tasks.

controls.title: Logical access control with NAC for authorized devices
controls.description: Control logical access to networks; deploy additional controls such as NAC to ensure access is restricted to authorized devices/services.
controls.full_text: Logical access to bank's networks must be controlled. Additional controls such as Network Access Control (NAC) should be deployed to ensure that access is restricted to authorized devices/services.

controls.title: Banners restricting access and stating legal terms
controls.description: Implement banners that proclaim access only permitted to authorized users abiding by security policies, system is monitored; define acceptable usage; spell out legal ramifications against misuse.
controls.full_text: The bank must implement banners that: a) Proclaim that access is only permitted to authorized users; the user has to abide by the relevant security policies and the system is monitored, b) Defines acceptable usage of the system. c) Spells out legal ramifications against misuse of the system.

controls.title: Mitigation of access-control bypass
controls.description: Effective controls to mitigate bypass/compromise of access control; if bypass required, obtain approvals from appropriate authorities; unauthorized attempts treated as security incidents under IR procedures and HR policy.
controls.full_text: Effective controls shall be in place to mitigate bypass/compromise of the access control system to gain access to information. If bypassing the access control mechanism is required, proper approval should be sought from the appropriate authorities. Any unauthorized attempts to circumvent access controls shall be perceived as security incidents and shall be dealt with under incident response procedures, as well as HR policy and procedures.

controls.title: No concurrent access to production and backup
controls.description: No-one shall have concurrent access to both production and backup systems; any backup/recovery resource access must be duly authorized for specific reason and timeframe.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that no-one has concurrent access to both production and backup systems. It must be ensured that any person who needs access to backup files or system recovery resources is duly authorized for a specific reason and timeframe.

controls.title: Unique identifier per user for accountability
controls.description: Ensure all users, contractors, third party and temporary staff are identified by a unique identifier so actions are accountable and traceable; users held responsible for actions performed using their IDs.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that all users, contractors, third party and temporary staff are identified by a unique identifier to ensure the actions are accountable and traceable. These identified users must be held responsible and accountable for actions performed using their IDs.

controls.title: Tight controls on anonymous/guest/shared accounts
controls.description: Anonymous guests and shared accounts carry non-repudiation risk and use should be discouraged; if necessary due to system limitations, operational procedures or emergency access, tightly control by technical/procedural mechanisms.
controls.full_text: Anonymous guests and shared accounts carry a potential risk of non-repudiation and therefore their use should be discouraged. In cases that such accounts are necessary due to system limitations, operational procedures or emergency access they should be tightly controlled by technical or procedural mechanisms.

controls.title: Default account renaming and password change
controls.description: Default accounts (admin, root, operator) must be renamed where technically feasible and default password changed; all changes documented.
controls.full_text: Default accounts, such as admin, root, operator, etc., where technically feasible, must be renamed and the default password must be changed. All the changes must be documented.

controls.title: Monitor and log all user and privileged accounts
controls.description: All user accounts including privileged accounts shall be monitored and logged for historical purposes.
controls.full_text: All user accounts, including privileged accounts, should be monitored and logged for historical purposes.

controls.title: Shared IDs tied to authorized users
controls.description: If unique IDs not technically possible, shared IDs must be tied to authorized users based on factors like time of use, location.
controls.full_text: In case there are technical, or any other limitation to assign unique IDs, the bank must ensure that the shared IDs are tied to authorized users based on factors such as time of use, location etc.

controls.title: No access for non-employees/contractors/3P
controls.description: Individuals who are not employee, contractor or third party must not be granted user account or any privilege within bank's system; exceptions require proper authority approval.
controls.full_text: Any individuals who are not an employee, contractor or third party must not be granted user account access or given any privilege within the bank's system. Any exceptions to this must be approved by the proper authority.

controls.title: Authentication mechanism with MFA for sensitive systems
controls.description: Access to system managed and controlled through appropriate authentication mechanism (password, access card etc.); based on sensitivity, system owner shall implement multifactor authentication.
controls.full_text: Access to the system shall be managed and controlled through an appropriate authentication mechanism, such as password, access card etc. Based on sensitivity, the system owner shall implement multifactor authentication.
evidence_requirements: MFA enrolment evidence for sensitive systems

controls.title: User access rights per business-rule access control matrix
controls.description: User access rights to create/read/update/delete/transmit bank's information assets based on access control matrix defined by business rules established by owners of the information.
controls.full_text: User access rights to create, read, update, delete or transmit the bank's information assets shall be based on an access control matrix defined by the business rules established by owners of the information.

controls.title: Authentication data protection in use
controls.description: System authentication data while in use protected and not susceptible to attacks like replay, man-in-the-middle, session hijacking.
controls.full_text: It must be ensured that system authentication data, while in use, is protected and it is not susceptible to attacks such as replay, man in the middle and session hijacking.

controls.title: Password policy with strong/complex passwords and 2FA consideration
controls.description: Define password policy and related procedures (e.g. password reset); employ best practices; enforce strong complex passwords; take two-factor authentication into consideration.
controls.full_text: The bank shall define password policy and related procedures, such as password reset. The password policy shall employ best practices, and enforce strong and complex password creation and take two factor authentication into consideration.

controls.title: Password rotation: 60-day max age, 1-day min age, change on first logon
controls.description: Password changed at least every 60 days, minimum age of 1 day; users forced to change at logon after expiry or after reset; controls ensure system complies with password policy.
controls.full_text: Password must be changed at least every 60 days and minimum age of 1 day. It must be ensured that users are forced to change the password at logon after expiry or after reset. In addition to this, controls should be implemented to ensure that the system complies with password policy.

controls.title: Screen lock configuration per policy
controls.description: Systems or devices must be configured to lock the screen as per bank's policies.
controls.full_text: Systems or devices must be configured to lock the screen as per the bank's policies.

controls.title: Account lockout: max 3 failed attempts, 30 min delay
controls.description: Suspend access after no more than three failed authentication attempts to prevent password brute forcing; delay login for at least 30 minutes after suspension.
controls.full_text: Access to the system must be suspended after no more than three failed authentication attempts, to prevent the guessing of passwords by brute forcing. The login must be delayed for at least 30 minutes after the suspension of the account.
evidence_requirements: Lockout threshold (3) and lockout duration (30 min) configuration

controls.title: Helpdesk-based password reset with user identification
controls.description: Policy for users of locked accounts to contact helpdesk for resetting passwords post confirmation and verification of users.
controls.full_text: There must be a policy in place for users of locked accounts to contact the helpdesk for resetting passwords post confirmation and verification of users.
evidence_requirements: Helpdesk password reset SOP with verification steps

controls.title: Inactivity suspension after 60 days and deletion if no longer needed
controls.description: Accounts not active for more than 60 days must be suspended; if account no longer needed, take necessary actions to initiate deletion from the system.
controls.full_text: Accounts that are not active for more than 60 days must be suspended. In case account is no longer needed, necessary actions shall be taken to initiate deletion of the account from the system.

controls.title: Audit trail for accounts processing highly classified info
controls.description: Audit trail enabled for accounts processing highly classified information; all successful and failed logins logged and reviewed in case of alert/incident.
controls.full_text: It must be ensured that an audit trail is enabled for accounts processing highly classified information; Audit trails such as all successful and failed logins shall logged for and shall be reviewed in case of an alert/ incident.
evidence_requirements: Review evidence for highly classified accounts

controls.title: System access SOPs with data type, users, schedule, method
controls.description: Define SOPs for system access including which data type can be accessed by whom (users/groups), timeframe (schedules), method (internal, external, VPN); define type local/remote and access for employees/contractors/3P/vendors.
controls.full_text: The bank shall define standard operating procedures for system access with details on which data type can be accessed by whom (users or groups), within which timeframe (schedules) and method of access (internal, external, VPN). The bank shall also define the type of access local/remote, access to employees, contractors, third parties and vendors.
evidence_requirements: Access matrices by user type and method

controls.title: Approval process for system access
controls.description: Define the approval process for system access and related access controls.
controls.full_text: The bank shall also define the approval process for system access and related access controls.

controls.title: Personnel security vetting for system users
controls.description: System users vetted in line with requirements specified in personnel security requirements.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that system users are vetted in line with the requirements specified in personnel security requirements.

controls.title: Pre-access training on responsibilities and acceptable usage
controls.description: Educate users on responsibilities, security awareness and acceptable usage prior to providing them with access to the system.
controls.full_text: The bank shall put in place controls to educate the users on their responsibilities, security awareness and acceptable usage prior to providing them with access to the system.

controls.title: Logging of privileged account activities
controls.description: System management logs configured to record privileged account activities including sanitization, system start/shutdown, system failure, maintenance, backup/archiving, recovery and out-of-office hour activity.
controls.full_text: System management logs shall be configured to record activities performed by privileged accounts. The activities shall include sanitization activity; system start up and shut down; system failure; maintenance activities; backup and archiving activity; system recovery activity and out of office hour activity.

controls.title: Separate day-to-day account for system administrators
controls.description: System administrators assigned different user account for performing day-to-day activities; privileged users supervised closely and all system activities logged and reviewed periodically.
controls.full_text: System administrators shall be assigned a different user account for performing normal day to day activities. Users with privileged access must be closely supervised and all their system activities logged and reviewed periodically

controls.title: Director and ISO approval for privileged account changes
controls.description: Updates, additions, deletions of privilege user accounts and/or passwords must be notified to the director and ISO; approval provided by director and ISO.
controls.full_text: Updates, additions, deletions of privilege user accounts and/or passwords must be notified to the director and Information Security Officer (ISO), approval for changes must be provided by the director and ISO.
evidence_requirements: Privileged account change requests with director and ISO approvals

controls.title: ISO updates master list of privileged users
controls.description: Post approval and changes reflected, ISO must update master list of privileged users and their access boundaries.
controls.full_text: Post approval and changes reflected, the ISO must update the master list of privileged users and their access boundaries.
evidence_requirements: Master privileged user list maintained by ISO

controls.title: Privileged users cannot access their own logs; no shared privileged accounts
controls.description: Privileged account users must not have access to system logs in which their activities are being logged; privileged accounts must not be shared between multiple users.
controls.full_text: Privileged account users must not have access to the system logs in which their activities are being logged. Privileged accounts must not be shared between multiple users.
evidence_requirements: Log-server ACLs preventing privileged user self-access

controls.title: Remote access only with business justification and approval
controls.description: Do not provide remote access unless warranted by business requirements and authorized by relevant department head and security team/department; consider risks before providing remote access.
controls.full_text: The bank shall not provide remote access to its users unless it is warranted by business requirements and authorized by the relevant department head and the security team/department. Risks associated with this shall be considered before providing remote access to users.

controls.title: Two-factor authentication for critical-system remote access
controls.description: Two-factor authentication must be used when accessing critical systems via remote access.
controls.full_text: Two factor authentication must be used when accessing critical systems via remote access.
evidence_requirements: MFA enforcement on remote access for critical systems

controls.title: End-to-end encrypted remote access sessions
controls.description: Remote access sessions must be encrypted end-to-end to secure info in transit; encryption begins with session initiation including user identification/authentication, until session is terminated.
controls.full_text: Remote access sessions must be encrypted from end to end to secure information in transit. Encryption must begin with the initiation of session and must include all user identification and authentication, and not end until the session is terminated.

controls.title: Personal firewall and anti-malware on remote endpoints
controls.description: Users cannot remotely access organization's system without sufficient controls such as personal firewall and anti-malware to protect user sessions.
controls.full_text: It must be ensured that users cannot remotely access the organization's system without sufficient controls such as personal firewall and anti-malware software to protect user sessions.
evidence_requirements: Posture check policy for personal firewall/AV

controls.title: Patched and up-to-date remote access security software
controls.description: Security software on remote access systems must be patched and kept up to date.
controls.full_text: Security software on the remote access systems must be patched and kept up to date.
evidence_requirements: Patch status reports of remote-access servers and clients

controls.title: No split-tunneling or dual-homing
controls.description: Reconfiguration of a remote access system for the purpose of split-tunneling or dual homing shall not be permitted.
controls.full_text: Reconfiguration of a remote access system for the purpose of split-tunneling or dual homing shall not be permitted.

controls.title: User responsibility for information assets per acceptable usage
controls.description: System users responsible for information assets provided to them; handle and operate per bank's acceptable usage policy.
controls.full_text: System users shall be responsible for information assets provided to them to perform their daily job responsibilities. They shall handle and operate the information assets in line with the bank's acceptable usage policy.

controls.title: Business-purpose-only resources awareness
controls.description: Users made aware that resources, including internet access, are for business purpose; personal usage prohibited and governed by policies.
controls.full_text: Users shall be made aware that resources provided by the bank, including access to the internet, are for business purpose. Personal usage of the assets shall be prohibited and governed by policies of the bank.

controls.title: Acceptable usage policy for information assets, internet and email
controls.description: Define acceptable usage policy for information assets including internet and email.
controls.full_text: The bank shall define an acceptable usage policy for its information assets, including the internet and email.

controls.title: Controls against all types of cyber-attacks
controls.description: Security controls in place to protect information systems assets against all types of cyber-attacks.
controls.full_text: The bank must make sure that security controls are put in place to protect information systems assets against all types of cyber-attacks.

controls.title: Policy and procedures for social media/forums
controls.description: Define policy and procedures for the usage of social media, forums etc.
controls.full_text: The bank shall define policy and procedures for the usage of social media, forums etc.

controls.title: Education on acceptable use of internet and email
controls.description: Educate users/third parties/contractors on acceptable usage of information assets and internet/email; awareness courses highlight effective usage.
controls.full_text: The bank must make sure that users, third party, contractors are educated on the acceptable usage of information assets and usage of the internet and email provided to them. The bank shall ensure that security awareness courses conducted by them highlight effective usage of the internet and email.

controls.title: No public webmail from bank systems
controls.description: Public web based email services shall not be used to send emails from the bank's systems.
controls.full_text: Public web based email services shall not be used to send emails from the bank's systems.
evidence_requirements: Web proxy block list including public webmail

controls.title: NDAs and risk assessment before sharing classified data
controls.description: External recipients/originators understand and agree on usage of classified data; NDA/confidentiality with external parties; risk assessments before data exchange.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that external recipients or originators understand and agree on the usage of classified data. Non-disclosure and confidentiality agreements shall be signed with external parties and necessary risk assessments shall be conducted before exchanging data with them.

controls.title: Controls preventing access to unauthorised sites and software installs
controls.description: Implement controls to prevent access to unauthorized websites and downloading/installing unauthorized software on user workstations.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement controls to prevent access to unauthorized web sites and downloading and installation of unauthorized software on the user's workstations.

controls.title: Web access through secure proxies and filtering gateways
controls.description: Web access shall be provided through secure proxies and filtering gateways.
controls.full_text: The web access shall be provided through secure proxies and filtering gateways.

controls.title: Email protection against viruses, phishing and spam
controls.description: Email protected against potential threats such as viruses, phishing and spam; implement email gateways to filter and manage email and contents.
controls.full_text: Email shall be protected against potential threats, such as viruses, phishing and spam. The bank shall implement email gateways to filter and manage the email and its contents.

controls.title: Basic user security hygiene education
controls.description: Educate users in basic security hygiene including: log off after task; do not install software/programs of unknown origin; delete and report spam/chain emails; do not open attachments from strangers and report them; sensitised to social engineering.
controls.full_text: The bank shall educate users in basic security hygiene to further enhance its security posture and shall follow the guidelines below, at a minimum: a. Users shall log off the online session after completion of tasks. b. Users shall not install software or run programs of unknown origin. c. Users shall delete spam or chain emails and report them to bank's security team. d. Users shall not open email attachments from strangers and shall report them to bank's security team. e. Users shall be sensitized to social engineering practices and shall be educated to not to divulge their personal and financial information to untrusted sources.

controls.title: Restriction of email on public forums and non-work sites
controls.description: Use of email on public forums and non-work related web sites must be restricted; user shall ensure emails are suitably classified per bank's classification policy.
controls.full_text: Use of email on the public forums and non-work related web sites must be restricted. The user shall ensure the emails are suitably classified, as per the bank's classification policy.
evidence_requirements: Acceptable use restrictions on bank email

controls.title: HLD/LLD maintained and reviewed quarterly or on significant changes
controls.description: Maintain HLD covering network/security architecture and LLD showing detailed connections; review on every significant network change or quarterly.
controls.full_text: A High Level Diagram (HLD) covering the overview of network and security architecture of the bank and a Low Level Diagram (LLD) showing detailed connections of this architecture, shall be maintained by the bank. Additionally, it must be reviewed on every significant network change, or on quarterly basis.

controls.title: Detailed inventory of network devices, servers and workstations
controls.description: Maintain detailed inventory of network devices, servers and workstations per asset management guidelines.
controls.full_text: The bank shall maintain a detailed inventory of network devices, servers and workstations, as per asset management guidelines.
evidence_requirements: CMDB / inventory of network devices, servers, workstations

controls.title: Defense-in-depth and secure-by-design network protection
controls.description: Establish network protection strategy and layered security based on 'defense in depth'; networks designed per 'secure by design' paradigm including: physical/logical segregation via routers/switches/firewalls/VLANs; port security/MAC filtering/sticky MAC and disabled unused ports; eliminated single points of failure; separate management VLAN for SSH/SNMP; infra changes per change mgmt; documented and quarterly-reviewed configurations; 802.1X/NAC network edge authentication; IDS/IPS on critical internal/external segments; 24/7 SOC; secure management access (SSH, IPSEC, MFA); AAA server for access/policy/auditing.
controls.full_text: Establishing a network protection strategy and layered security based on the principle of 'defense in depth' is an absolute necessity for a bank. The bank must ensure that networks are designed as per 'secure by design' paradigm in order to limit the compromise of confidential information. This shall be achieved by following leading practices, industry wide benchmarks and vendor recommendations, and include the following: a. Network must be segregated physically using routers, switches and firewalls and logically using VLANs. Switches must be deployed instead of hubs in order to prevent network sniffing on the same subnet. b. At minimum, port security, MAC filtering or sticky MAC address must be configured on routers, switches and wireless controllers to prevent unauthorized access and enhance security posture. Additionally, unused network ports must be disabled. c. Single point of failure must be identified and eliminated in the production network. d. Network control and management traffic such as SSH, SNMP must be transmitted through a separate management VLAN or a physically separate segment. e. Infrastructure changes must be performed and executed, as per the guidelines specified in the change management section. f. The bank must ensure that configuration of network devices is documented and updated post every change. Controls must be enforced to ensure that the configuration is reviewed on a quarterly basis to identify any unauthorized changes. Additionally, the running configuration of network devices must be compared against the documented configuration to ensure its integrity. g. Network edge authentication, such as 802.1X, NAC must be implemented to prevent unauthorized access to the bank network. h. The bank must implement Intrusion Prevention and Intrusion Detection systems (IPS/IDS) in their critical internal and external network segments to prevent/detect network attacks. i. The bank must establish a 24/7 network and security operations center (SOC) for the monitoring of network and infrastructure devices. j. Management access to the network and infrastructure devices must be provisioned through secure channels, such as SSH, IPSEC through multifactor authentication, wherever applicable. k. An Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting (AAA) server must be deployed for managing access, enforcing policies and auditing usage of network, security and infrastructure devices.

controls.title: Audit trails for critical devices reviewed on alert/incident
controls.description: Audit trails of daily activities for critical devices maintained and reviewed in case of alert/incident.
controls.full_text: Audit trails of daily activities for critical devices must be maintained and reviewed in case of an alert/ incident.

controls.title: Semi-annual VA/PT of infrastructure and network devices
controls.description: Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing of infrastructure and network devices performed semi-annually per VA/PT guidelines.
controls.full_text: Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing of infrastructure and network devices must be performed on a semi-annual basis as specified in the vulnerability assessment and penetration testing guidelines.

controls.title: Disable/remove default accounts and change default passwords
controls.description: Disable or remove default accounts (if applicable) such as root and administrator, and change default passwords per password management policy.
controls.full_text: The bank must disable or remove default accounts (if applicable), such as root and administrator, and must change the default passwords. The passwords must be set, as per the password management policy defined by the bank.

controls.title: Risk analysis for application network access
controls.description: Perform and document risk analysis for each application requiring network access; terminate unnecessary/unidentified connections to critical networks.
controls.full_text: Risk analysis must be performed and documented for each application requiring network access. Unnecessary and unidentified connections to critical networks must be terminated.

controls.title: Minimum security baseline for infrastructure hardening
controls.description: Define minimum security baseline for hardening of infrastructure devices (servers, VMs, printers, firewalls, routers, switches) based on industry leading practices, existing standards and vendor recommendations; review and update biannually.
controls.full_text: A minimum security baseline for the hardening of infrastructure devices, such as servers, virtual machines, printers, firewalls, routers and switches, must be defined by the bank. These guidelines shall be formulated based on industry leading practices, existing standards and vendor recommendations. These baseline and hardening documents must be reviewed and updated on a biannual basis.

controls.title: Admin access monitoring per logging guidelines
controls.description: Administrator access to bank's network and infrastructure must be monitored and reviewed per logging and security monitoring guidelines.
controls.full_text: Access to the bank's network and infrastructure by administrators must be monitored and reviewed as per the logging and security monitoring guidelines.

controls.title: Restricted access to logs with review and backup
controls.description: Access to logs restricted to prevent modification/deletion; logs reviewed and backed up per log management and backup guidelines.
controls.full_text: Access to the logs shall be restricted to prevent modification or deletion. Logs must be reviewed and backed up, as per the log management and backup guidelines.

controls.title: Pre-change assessment for network additions/changes
controls.description: Have assessment process to ensure security for additions/changes to network devices and infrastructure; ensure change does not impose vulnerability to other parts.
controls.full_text: The bank must have an assessment process in place to ensure security for additions or changes to network devices and infrastructure. This ensures that the change does not impose a point of vulnerability to other parts of network.
evidence_requirements: Pre-implementation security assessment for network changes

controls.title: Strong application and network level encryption
controls.description: Implement strong application-level encryption (e.g. AES or TLS) for transport and strong network-level encryption to protect data used and processed by the application.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement strong application level encryption mechanism (such as AES or TLS) for transport and strong network level encryption to protect the data used, and processed by the application.
evidence_requirements: TLS/AES configuration on apps and networks

controls.title: Separate cabling/routing/distribution for highly classified info
controls.description: Ensure separate cabling, routing and distribution for info systems dealing with highly confidential, critical and sensitive information for physical segregation and protection.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure separate cabling, routing and distribution for information systems dealing with highly confidential, critical and sensitive information. This will ensure physical segregation of infrastructure and protection against attacks if systems of lower classifications are compromised.

controls.title: Cable register with annual inspection
controls.description: Maintain cable register with cable ID, classification, source, destination, floor plan diagram; inspect cables per register at least annually for inconsistencies.
controls.full_text: A cable register must be maintained for data that at least documents the following attributes: cable identification number, classification, source, destination and floor plan diagram. The cables must be inspected, in accordance with the cable register, for inconsistencies at least on an annual basis.

controls.title: Disable remote initiation of conferencing equipment
controls.description: Disable remote initiation of conferencing equipment to mitigate risk of conversation snooping by remote means.
controls.full_text: Remote initiation of conferencing equipment shall be disabled to mitigate the risk of conversation snooping by remote means.
evidence_requirements: Conferencing equipment configuration disabling remote initiation

controls.title: E2E encryption for fax/MFDs
controls.description: Secure facsimile/fax-enabled MFDs by implementing end-to-end encryption (hardware appliance or software application) to avoid data sniffing.
controls.full_text: Facsimile (fax) devices or fax enabled Multi-functional Devices (MFDs) must be secured by implementing end to end encryption, if applicable, by the means of hardware appliance or software application to avoid sniffing of data.

controls.title: Cables protected by appropriate conduit
controls.description: Cables must be protected from tampering, sabotage or accidental damage by encasing in appropriate conduit.
controls.full_text: Cables must be protected from tampering, sabotage or accidental damage by encasing them into appropriate conduit.

controls.title: Redundant communication pathways
controls.description: Provision redundant communication pathways to ensure continued connectivity through auxiliary routes for availability against sabotage or accidental damage.
controls.full_text: Redundant communication pathways shall be provisioned to ensure continued connectivity through auxiliary routes. This will ensure availability of the communication network in case of sabotage or accidental damage.

controls.title: Unlabeled conduits in public/visitor areas
controls.description: Conduits installed in public or visitor areas must not be labelled in a manner that discloses their purpose or attracts undue attention.
controls.full_text: Conduits installed in public or visitor areas must not labelled in a manner that discloses their purpose or attracts undue attention.
evidence_requirements: Conduit labelling guidelines for public areas

controls.title: Separate management VLAN; disable VLAN 1
controls.description: Administrative access and network control traffic permitted from separate management VLAN for isolation/security; VLAN 1 disabled or not used for management traffic.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that administrative access and network control traffic is permitted from a separate management VLAN to ensure isolation and security. Additionally, it must be ensured that VLAN 1 is disabled or not used for management traffic.

controls.title: Prioritized QoS and separate STP instance for control traffic
controls.description: Network control or administrative traffic categorized with prioritized QoS values; administrative VLAN and network control VLAN run in separate Spanning Tree Protocol instance for path resilience.
