controls.full_text: Network control or administrative traffic must be categorized with prioritized QoS values. Additionally, administrative VLAN and network control traffic VLAN must be run in a separate Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) instance to ensure path resilience.

controls.title: VLAN pruning on trunk interfaces
controls.description: VLANs pruned on trunk interface to avoid piggy backing of data.
controls.full_text: It must be ensured that VLAN's are pruned on the trunk interface to avoid piggy backing of data.

controls.title: VoIP traffic segregation and QoS
controls.description: VoIP traffic segregated logically or physically to prevent voice-network attacks; dedicated QoS for VoIP for uninterrupted optimized flows.
controls.full_text: VOIP traffic must be segregated (either logically or physically) to prevent attacks on voice networks. Appropriate Quality of Service (QoS) must be dedicatedly defined for VOIP traffic for ensuring uninterrupted and optimized network flows.

controls.title: MFD hardening baseline and user education
controls.description: Define minimum security baseline for hardening of MFDs; educate users on proper usage governing the use of equipment.
controls.full_text: A minimum security baseline for hardening of the MFDs must be defined by the bank. Additionally, users must be educated on the proper usage of MFDs governing the use of the equipment.

controls.title: Authentication, encryption and auditing on MFDs
controls.description: Ensure appropriate authentication, encryption and auditing functions are enabled on MFDs where applicable.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that appropriate authentication, encryption and auditing functions are enabled on MFDs, if applicable.

controls.title: Physical security for MFDs
controls.description: MFDs subject to appropriate physical security controls against thefts in line with physical security guidelines.
controls.full_text: MFD's shall be subjected to appropriate physical security controls against thefts in line with the physical security guidelines.
evidence_requirements: Physical security controls for MFDs (cable locks, restricted areas)

controls.title: MFD firmware review
controls.description: Banks recommended to conduct a review on the version of the firmware of MFD devices.
controls.full_text: The bank are recommended to conduct a review on the version of the firmware of the MFD devices.
evidence_requirements: MFD firmware inventory and review records

controls.title: DNS zone integrity and mutual authentication
controls.description: Zone files digitally signed; integrity of zone transfers maintained; cryptographic origin and mutual authentication maintained.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that zone files are digitally signed and the integrity of zone transfers is maintained. Additionally, it must be ensured that cryptographic origin and mutual authentication is maintained.

controls.title: Dedicated DNS firewall against C&C/botnet abuse
controls.description: Implement dedicated DNS firewall to protect against malware using DNS to communicate with command-and-control sites and botnets.
controls.full_text: Traditional firewalls and IPS do not generally intercept and map DNS communications to malicious locations. A dedicated DNS firewall must be implemented to protect against malware that uses DNS to communicate with command-and-control (C&C) sites and botnets.

controls.title: Redundant internal/external DNS in DMZ with NGFW
controls.description: Implement redundant internal and external DNS for segregation of name server info; harden public-facing DNS in DMZ; implement dedicated DNS firewall or NGFW.
controls.full_text: Redundant internal and external DNS must be implemented for segregation of name server information. Public facing DNS must be hardened as per established baselines and should be placed in a Demilitarized Zone (DMZ). Furthermore, a dedicated DNS firewall or Next Generation Firewall (NGFW) must be implemented to protect against malware that uses DNS to communicate with command-and-controls sites and botnets.

controls.title: Dedicated firewalls and content filtering with DPI
controls.description: Implement dedicated firewalls and content filtering gateways to ensure internet downloads/files are scanned and verified; enable Deep Packet Inspection (DPI).
controls.full_text: Dedicated firewalls and content filtering gateways must be implemented to ensure that software and files downloaded from the internet or public networks are scanned and verified. In addition to this, mechanisms to perform Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) shall be enabled.

controls.title: Explicit deny on internet gateways and hardening
controls.description: Internet gateways have explicit deny rule to block traffic unless specifically allowed by exception; internet gateways (router, firewalls or L3 switch) hardened per hardening guidelines.
controls.full_text: Internet gateways must have an explicit deny rule configured to block traffic unless specifically allowed on an exceptional basis. Additionally, it must be ensured that internet gateways (router, firewalls or L3 switch) must be hardened, as per bank hardening guidelines.

controls.title: Internal/external traffic pattern monitoring
controls.description: Capability to monitor internal and external traffic to identify and understand traffic patterns.
controls.full_text: The bank must have the capability to monitor internal and external traffic to identify and understand traffic patterns.

controls.title: SPF verification of bounce emails
controls.description: SPF detects email spoofing; email server configured to send undeliverable/bounce emails to senders that can be verified via SPF.
controls.full_text: Sender Policy Framework (SPF) is designed to detect email spoofing by checking that incoming mail comes from a trusted source authorized by that domain's administrators. It must be ensured that the email sever is configured to send undeliverable or bounce emails to senders that can be verified via SPF.

controls.title: Restricted distribution lists, auto-responses and legal disclaimers
controls.description: Restrict use of email distribution lists for internal usage; limit auto-responses (out-of-office) to approved/specific roles to curb malicious/spam emails; incorporate legally binding disclaimers in outgoing emails.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that the use of email distribution lists is restricted, as much as possible, for internal usage. Additionally, auto responses, such as out-of-office reply emails, should be limited to approved and specific roles in order to curb the spread of malicious or spam emails. Legally binding disclaimers shall be incorporated into outgoing emails.

controls.title: Redundant email servers for HA
controls.description: Implement redundant email servers in the infrastructure to ensure high availability.
controls.full_text: It shall be ensured that redundant email servers are implemented in the infrastructure to ensure high availability.

controls.title: Email server hardening
controls.description: Email servers hardened per bank's hardening guidelines.
controls.full_text: Email servers must be hardened as per the bank's hardening guidelines.

controls.title: Anti-spam gateway, content filtering, TLS email encryption
controls.description: Integrate anti-spam gateway with email server; implement scanning and content filtering; enable TLS email encryption per cryptographic policy.
controls.full_text: The bank shall integrate an anti-spam gateway with the email server to prevent spam emails. Additionally, scanning and content filtering solutions shall be implemented to ensure emails comply with the bank's security policy. Email encryption such as TLS must be enabled on the email server in accordance with the cryptographic policy.

controls.title: WLAN with auth/transmission security; isolated from bank infrastructure
controls.description: Deploy WLANs with authentication and transmission security; WAPs registered/approved by Information Security team; risk assessment prior to WLAN; WLAN must be logically and physically isolated with no connectivity to bank infrastructure.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure Wireless Local Area Networks (WLANs) are deployed with authentication and transmission security measures. Wireless Access Points (WAP) connected to the bank's network must be registered and approved by the bank's Information Security team/department. A risk assessment must be performed prior to implementation of a WLAN. Wireless LAN (WLAN) network used at banks shall be a logically and physically isolated network with no connectivity to the bank infrastructure.

controls.title: Latest encryption (no WEP); EAP/TLS or PEAP for clients
controls.description: Wireless network configured with the latest encryption; Wired Equivalent Privacy (WEP) shall not be implemented; clients use EAP/Transport Layer Security (TLS) or Protected Extensible Authentication Protocol (PEAP) to mitigate unauthorized access from compromised credentials.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that the wireless network is configured with the latest encryption in place. Wired Equivalent Privacy protocol shall not be implemented within the network. Additionally, wireless clients shall use EAP/Transport Layer Security (TLS) or Protected Extensible Authentication Protocol (PEAP) to mitigate the risk of unauthorized access from compromised credentials.

controls.title: Dynamic key exchange with encrypted VPN over wireless
controls.description: Deploy dynamic key exchange with encrypted VPN if confidential data is communicated over wireless networks.
controls.full_text: Dynamic key exchange with encrypted VPN shall be deployed if confidential data is required to be communicated over wireless networks.

controls.title: Wireless inventory; SSID/key change on loss; no personal devices
controls.description: Maintain inventory of wireless interface cards including APs, repeaters, laptops, workstations per asset management policy; on stolen/missing device change encryption keys and SSID parameters for all users; personal devices not connected to bank's network without Information Security approval.
controls.full_text: Inventory of wireless interface cards including APs, repeaters, laptops and workstations must be maintained in accordance to bank's asset management policy. In case, a device is reported stolen or missing, the bank must change the encryption keys and SSID parameters for all the users. Personal devices shall not be connected on bank's network without the approval of the Information Security function.

controls.title: Rogue AP detection and quarterly wireless pentests
controls.description: Periodically scan for rogue and improperly configured wireless infrastructure; remove/reconfigure; quarterly penetration tests and audits of wireless infrastructure.
controls.full_text: The bank shall periodically scan for rogue and improperly configured wireless infrastructure devices. Identified devices shall be removed from the network, or have their configurations altered to comply with the information security requirements of the bank. Additionally, wireless infrastructure shall be subjected to quarterly penetration tests and audits, as per the vulnerability assessment and penetration testing guidelines.

controls.title: WAP hardening; hidden SSID; no info disclosure
controls.description: Wireless APs/gateways hardened per hardening guidelines; SSID, encryption keys, SNMP strings or any insecure configuration changed at installation; SSID remains hidden and does not divulge bank/system/product name.
controls.full_text: Wireless access points and gateways shall be hardened, as per the bank's hardening guidelines. Parameters such as SSID, encryption keys, SNMP strings or any insecure configuration shall be changed at the time of installation. Additionally, it shall be ensured that SSID shall remain hidden and must not divulge any information such as the bank's name, system name or product name.

controls.title: Firewall between WAP and internal network; MAC filtering where applicable
controls.description: WLAN secured by implementing firewall between access point and internal network; explicit deny of incoming connections on unknown ports; MAC address filtering where applicable.
controls.full_text: Wireless LAN networks must be secured by implementing a firewall between the access point and the internal network. In addition, firewalls must be configured to explicitly deny incoming connections on unknown ports. Wherever applicable MAC address filtering shall be considered.

controls.title: NTP server hardening
controls.description: Network Time Protocol (NTP) servers must be hardened per bank's hardening guidelines.
controls.full_text: Network Time Protocol (NTP) servers must be hardened as per the bank's hardening guidelines.

controls.title: NTP authentication with MD5
controls.description: Configure NTP authentication using MD5 for devices synchronizing with NTP server; NTP server must not respond to unauthenticated NTP requests.
controls.full_text: NTP authentication using MD5 must be configured for devices synchronizing with an NTP server. Additionally, the NTP server must not respond to unauthenticated NTP requests.

controls.title: Sync to agreed real-time standard with variation testing
controls.description: Network/infrastructure devices synchronize to NTP server; NTP server syncs to agreed real-time standard (national/international atomic clocks or government NTP server); controls test for variations between NTP server and standard reference time source.
controls.full_text: The network and infrastructure devices must synchronize to the NTP server and the NTP server shall itself sync to an agreed real time standard. These standards can be national atomic clocks, international atomic clocks or a government NTP server. Additionally, controls shall be in place to test for variations between the NTP server and standard reference time source.
evidence_requirements: NTP source list (atomic clock / govt NTP)

controls.title: VPN access policy with management approval and monthly review
controls.description: Establish policies restricting VPN access; enforce controls to monitor remote-access devices; VPN access requires compelling business need and management approval; monthly user access reconciliation to revoke unjustified access.
controls.full_text: The bank shall establish policies restricting VPN access and enforce controls to monitor remote-access devices. VPN access shall be restricted by enforcing controls unless a compelling business need exists and must require management approval. User access reconciliation shall be performed and reviewed on a monthly basis, to revoke accesses that no longer have a compelling business justification.

controls.title: Two-factor auth before VPN tunnel; hardware/software token + Radius/LDAP/AD/TACACS+
controls.description: Two factor authentication enabled for VPN connections prior to establishing VPN tunnel; hardware or software token primary authentication followed by integrated Radius, LDAP, AD or TACACS+ authentication.
controls.full_text: Two factor authentication must be enabled for VPN connections prior to establishing the VPN tunnel. A hardware or software token shall act as primary authentication followed by an integrated Radius, LDAP, AD or TACACS+ authentication.

controls.title: No split tunneling unless suitable controls in place
controls.description: Split tunneling not permitted for VPN connections unless suitable controls (host-based content filtering agents, end-point proxy systems, DLP solutions) are implemented.
controls.full_text: Split tunneling shall not be permitted for VPN connections unless suitable controls such as host based content filtering agents, end point proxy systems and data leakage solutions are implemented at the bank.
evidence_requirements: VPN client policy (no split tunnel by default)

controls.title: Uniform cryptographic standards for VPN
controls.description: Establish, document and enforce cryptographic standards for VPN encryption and parameters uniform across organisation.
controls.full_text: Bank's must establish, document and enforce cryptographic standards for VPN encryption and parameters. These must be uniform across organization.

controls.title: Posture assessment of remote computers
controls.description: Configure posture assessment for remote computers connecting via VPN; ensure systems equipped with updated security software, latest patches, anti-virus, anti-malware and repair configurations.
controls.full_text: Posture assessment must be configured for remote computers connecting to bank's networks via VPN. This would ensure that the systems are equipped with updated security software, latest security patches, anti-virus, anti-malware software and repair configurations.

controls.title: VPN inactivity timeouts; site-to-site coverage
controls.description: Configure VPN inactivity timeouts; expiration requires re-login; curbs exploitation of unattended VPN sessions; extends to site-to-site VPN tunnels per network design.
controls.full_text: VPN inactivity timeouts must be configured for VPN connections, following expiration of these connections the user shall be required to re-login to the system. It will curb the risk of exploitation of an unattended VPN session by a malicious user. Additionally, this will ensure better utilization of network and system resources. This control must further be extended to site-to-site VPN tunnels as per the network design.

controls.title: VPN access logging and monitoring
controls.description: Enable logging, monitoring and recording of VPN access in line with logging and monitoring guidelines.
controls.full_text: The bank must enable logging, monitoring and recording of VPN access in line with logging and monitoring guidelines.

controls.title: Modems disabled by default; enabled only on authorized request
controls.description: Modems must be unplugged or disabled by default; if required, VPN access through modems for authorized requests; disable modems once request completed.
controls.full_text: Modems must be unplugged or disabled by default. If required, VPN access through modems must be provided for authorized requests. Once the request is completed, modems shall be disabled.

controls.title: VPN concentrators in DMZ with firewall and IPS
controls.description: VPN concentrators deployed in DMZ protected by firewall and IPS; gateway firewalls and IPS help control, monitor and analyze traffic from VPN endpoints to trusted sources.
controls.full_text: VPN concentrators shall be deployed in a DMZ, protected by a firewall and an IPS solution. Gateway firewalls and IPS will help in controlling, monitoring and analyzing traffic from VPN endpoints to trusted sources.

controls.title: Risk assessment before trusted network connectivity (cascaded/untrusted)
controls.description: Before establishing trusted network connectivity, perform risk assessment considering cascaded connections with untrusted networks; evaluate, understand and accept threats/risks of other domains; document risk assessment for compliance.
controls.full_text: Prior to establishing trusted network connectivity, the bank must perform a thorough risk assessment which shall consider the risks of any identified cascaded connections particularly with an untrusted network. Additionally, the bank must evaluate, understand and accept the threats and risks of other domains. The subjected risk assessment shall be documented for compliance requirements.
evidence_requirements: Risk assessment for trusted network connectivity

controls.title: Reliable courier for transporting physical assets
controls.description: Use reliable and trusted courier service for transporting physical assets; controls maintain adequate protection for physical media in transit and at rest against hazards rendering contents unreadable/unrecoverable.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that a reliable and trusted courier service is used for transporting physical assets. Controls shall be ensured to maintain adequate levels of protection for physical media in transit and at rest against any hazard that may render the contents unreadable or unrecoverable.

controls.title: Controls for electronic information exchange
controls.description: Formulate controls to protect information exchanged via electronic channels from unauthorized access or interruption of service.
controls.full_text: Controls shall be formulated by the bank to protect information exchanged via electronic channels from unauthorized access or interruption of service.

controls.title: Trained media spokesperson
controls.description: Appoint well-trained media relations spokesperson to provide approved info to stakeholders and general masses via media outlets.
controls.full_text: A well-trained media relations spokesperson shall be appointed by the bank to provide approved information to stakeholders and general masses via media outlets.

controls.title: Information exchange agreements and NDAs
controls.description: Prior to exchanging info, ensure required agreements between entities are signed; details responsibilities, notification procedures, technical standards for transmission, identification of couriers, liabilities, ownership and controls; for vendors and third parties sign formal NDA.
controls.full_text: Prior to exchanging any information, it must be ensured that the required agreements between the entities exchanging information have been signed. The subjected agreements must detail responsibilities, information exchange notification procedures and technical standards for transmission, identification of couriers, liabilities, ownership and controls. Additionally, for vendors and third parties, a formal Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) shall be signed.
evidence_requirements: Signed NDAs with vendors and third parties

controls.title: Dual control and 4-eye principle for confidential-info gateways
controls.description: Administrative access to gateways transmitting confidential info provided on dual control and 4-eye principle; gateways maintained by trained, experienced and authorized staff.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that the administrative access to gateways transmitting confidential information is provided on dual control and on the 4 eye principle. The bank shall ensure that network gateways are maintained by trained, experienced and authorized staff.
evidence_requirements: Authorised staff roster with training records

controls.title: Gateway hardening minimum parameters
controls.description: Network gateways hardened prior to production deployment covering: latest vendor-approved tested firmware; configured per leading secure practices; account compromise/privilege escalation protections; rogue network monitoring; DoS protection; information leakage protection; deny connections by default unless authorized.
controls.full_text: Network gateways shall be hardened prior to deployment in the production environment, as per the hardening guidelines. It shall be ensured that gateways are hardened following the below mentioned parameters at a minimum: a. Latest vendor approved and tested firmware for protection against malicious code and firmware vulnerabilities. b. Configured as per leading secure practices. c. Account compromise and privilege escalation. d. Rogue network monitoring. e. Denial of service (DoS) attacks. f. Information leakage. g. Deny connections by default unless authorized.

controls.title: Gateway integration with logging and real-time monitoring
controls.description: Gateways integrated with logging and real-time monitoring solutions to detect security breaches and network intrusions.
controls.full_text: Gateways must be integrated with logging and real time monitoring solutions to detect security breaches and network intrusions.

controls.title: Big data analytics, IP reputation and advanced threat management
controls.description: Recommended to integrate gateways with big data analytics, IP reputation services and advanced threat management solutions to enhance security posture.
controls.full_text: It is recommended that gateways be integrated with big data analytics, IP reputation services and advanced threat management solutions for enhancing the security posture of the bank.

controls.title: Virtualization risk assessment
controls.description: Evaluate and identify risks associated with virtualization technologies with respect to legal regulations and legislations; risk assessments to understand impact of virtualization on existing infrastructure and current risk posture.
controls.full_text: The bank must evaluate and identify the risks associated with virtualization technologies with respect to legal regulations and legislations. Additionally, risk assessments must be performed to understand the impact of virtualization on the existing infrastructure and current risk posture.

controls.title: VM/hypervisor/admin system hardening practices
controls.description: VM, hypervisor, administration systems and connected systems hardened: resource limits per VM (CPU/memory/disk/vNIC); RBAC least-privilege on each VM; peripheral devices disallowed by default; file sharing disallowed without risk assessment to prevent VM hyperjacking/VM escape; unnecessary programs/services disabled; separate credentials for VM and host OS; VMs protected by local firewall and host OS firewall.
controls.full_text: VM, Operating System (OS) hypervisor, administration systems and other systems connected to VM environment shall be hardened, as per the hardening guidelines. The following practices shall be observed for securing the VMs at a minimum: a. It must be ensured that limits are set on the use of resources such as processors, memory, disk space, virtual network interfaces on each VM. b. Role-based access controls based on the principal of least privileges must be individually enforced on each VM. c. VMs shall be configured by default to disallow peripheral physical devices unless explicitly configured with a business need. d. File sharing shall be disallowed between the host machine and VMs unless adequate risk assessment has been performed to prevent attacks such as VM hyper jacking and VM escape. e. Unnecessary programs and services must be disabled on VMs. f. Wherever possible, separate credentials must be used for managing VM and host OS. g. VMs must be protected by a local firewall and a firewall configured on the host OS. The firewalls need to be configured as per the bank's Information Security practices.

controls.title: Physical and logical controls on virtual environment
controls.description: Enforce physical and logical security controls to prevent unauthorized access to virtual environment.
controls.full_text: Physical and logical security controls shall be enforced to prevent unauthorized access to the virtual environment.
evidence_requirements: Physical access controls to virtualization hosts

controls.title: Change management and patching for virtual environment
controls.description: Adhere to change management policy for any virtual environment changes; patch and update VMs per patch management policy.
controls.full_text: The change management policy shall be adhered to prior to any changes in the virtual environment. Additionally, VMs shall be patched and updated as per the patch management policy.

controls.title: VM logging per logging guidelines
controls.description: VM logging enabled, monitored and stored per logging and system monitoring guidelines.
controls.full_text: Logging for the VM's shall be enabled, monitored and stored as per the logging and system monitoring guidelines.

controls.title: Database hardening
controls.description: Databases and subsystems hardened per bank's hardening guidelines; parameters such as default password, connection strings, SNMP communities or insecure configuration changed at installation.
controls.full_text: Databases and its subsystems shall be hardened as per the bank's hardening guidelines. Parameters such as default password, connection strings, SNMP communities or any insecure configuration shall be changed at the time of installation.

controls.title: DB access by least privilege and RBAC; classified info
controls.description: Access to information in a database governed by least privilege and RBAC; information stored classified per information classification policy.
controls.full_text: Access to information in a database shall be governed by the principle of least privilege and role based access controls. Information stored in the database shall be classified as per the information classification policy.

controls.title: Restrict DB file access using views/kernel functions
controls.description: Normal access controls of database not bypassed for unauthorized access; restrict access to database file using techniques such as implementing database views and system kernel functions.
controls.full_text: It must be ensured that the normal access controls of database are not bypassed to protect it from unauthorized access. This can be achieved by restricting access to database file using techniques, such as implementing database views and system kernel functions.
evidence_requirements: DB views and OS-level file protections

controls.title: Individual DBA OS accounts; group accounts only for automated jobs
controls.description: OS accounts used by DBAs for administrative duties shall be individual accounts, not shared group; group account permitted only for running automated DBA maintenance/monitoring jobs (e.g. backups).
controls.full_text: It is recommended that operating system accounts used by DBA staff to login to data server machines for administrative duties shall be individual accounts and not a shared group account. A group account shall be permitted for running automated DBA maintenance and monitoring jobs, such as backups.

controls.title: DB access logged and reviewed; archived to enterprise log server
controls.description: Access to databases logged and reviewed by DBAs and information security team on periodic basis; logs archived on enterprise log server based on log retention policy.
controls.full_text: Access to databases must be logged and reviewed by the DBAs and information security team on a periodic basis. The logs must be archived on an enterprise log server based on the log retention policy of the bank.

controls.title: Encryption and key management for critical DB data
controls.description: Databases storing critical and confidential information shall be encrypted; documented procedures for secure key management per cryptographic policy.
controls.full_text: Database storing critical and confidential information shall be encrypted and procedures for secure key management shall be documented as per cryptographic policy.

controls.title: DB patching per patch management policy
controls.description: Database patched per patch management policy; provisions to maintain security patch levels in timely fashion.
controls.full_text: Database shall be patched, as per the patch management policy. Provisions must be made to maintain security patch levels in a timely fashion.

controls.title: Information classification policy based on leading standards
controls.description: Define information classification policy based on leading industry standards (ISO 27001, NIST); scheme classifies data based on sensitivity and impact; minimum classifications 'restricted', 'private' and 'public'.
controls.full_text: The bank shall define an information classification policy based on leading industry standards, such as ISO 27001, NIST. The scheme shall classify the data based on the sensitivity and impact. The classification of data determines the appropriate safeguards for security on data. At minimum, the data shall be classified as for example 'restricted', 'private' and 'public'.

controls.title: Confidential-by-default for unlabelled assets
controls.description: Information assets not classified/labelled (draft, incomplete, tampered) shall be labelled as 'confidential by default'.
controls.full_text: Information assets which are not classified or labelled due to reasons such as the document is in draft stage, is incomplete or the existing label has been tampered with or damaged, it shall be ensured that these assets are labelled as 'confidential by default'.
evidence_requirements: Default classification policy for unlabelled assets

controls.title: Default-private marking
controls.description: All information should be marked as 'private' unless it is specifically created for public release or consumption.
controls.full_text: All information should be marked as 'private' unless it is specifically created for public release or consumption.

controls.title: Process owner responsibility for data identification, classification and removal
controls.description: Business process owners responsible for identifying and classifying all tangible/intangible data assets the process collects/maintains and their removal.
controls.full_text: The business process owners within the bank shall be responsible for identifying and classifying all tangible and intangible data assets that the business process collects or maintains and their removal.

controls.title: Classification marking aligned to C-I-A ratings
controls.description: All classified information shall be suitably marked for identification in line with the C-I-A ratings.
controls.full_text: All classified information shall be suitably marked for identification in line with the C-I-A ratings.

controls.title: Awareness of data labelling and need to know
controls.description: Users and audiences (staff, employees, partners) made aware of data labelling, need to know and infosec implications.
controls.full_text: Users and audiences of information which includes staff, employees and partners shall be made aware of data labelling, need to know and its implication on information security.

controls.title: Safe and encrypted storage of sensitive data
controls.description: Ensure details of internal networks, system configurations, personally identifiable data, employee details, media, directory services and other sensitive info stored safely and encrypted.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that details of internal networks, system configurations, personally identifiable data, employee details, media, directory services and other sensitive information are stored safely and encrypted.
evidence_requirements: Encryption-at-rest configuration for listed data categories

controls.title: Need-to-know information access with approvals
controls.description: Information made available on specific requirements and need-to-know basis; access provided based on request and after approvals.
controls.full_text: Information must be made available on specific requirements and on a need to know basis. Access to information shall be provided based on request and after getting approvals.

controls.title: Privacy incident handling and reporting procedures
controls.description: Define and enforce comprehensive incident handling and reporting procedures for privacy incidents (stealing/loss/leakage of customer data) in line with bank's security incident management guidelines; refer to best national and international standard practices.
controls.full_text: To contain and minimize the possible impact of incidents involving stealing, loss or leakage of customer data (privacy incidents), the bank must define and enforce comprehensive incident handling and reporting procedures in line with bank's security incident management guidelines. The bank may refer to best national and international standard practices.

controls.title: Encryption of sensitive data transmitted to external parties
controls.description: Encipher sensitive data transmitted externally using cryptographically strong industry standards (RSA, SHA) to ensure protection of data at rest, in transit or in use per cryptographic policy.
controls.full_text: The bank must encipher sensitive data which is transmitted to external parties by using cryptographically strong industry standards, such as RSA, SHA to ensure protection of data at rest, in transit or in use as per the cryptographic policy.
evidence_requirements: Encryption configuration for external data transmission

controls.title: Detection of suspicious data activities
controls.description: Put in place controls for detection of suspicious activities regarding access, modification or transfer of data.
controls.full_text: The bank must put in place controls for detection of suspicious activities regarding access, modification or transfer of data.

controls.title: Endpoint DLP against portable storage data loss
controls.description: Enforce measures to address risk of unauthorized downloading of customer data to portable storage media and loss of such media containing sensitive info by implementing endpoint DLP solutions.
controls.full_text: The bank must enforce measures to address the risk of unauthorized downloading of customer data to portable storage media and loss of such media containing sensitive information by implementing endpoint DLP solutions.

controls.title: Disable portable storage ports; isolated environment for media access
controls.description: Disable portable storage media ports of computers and use isolated environment to access portable storage media.
controls.full_text: The bank shall disable the portable storage media ports of computers and use isolated environment to access portable storage media.

controls.title: Outsourcing data security/leakage compliance
controls.description: For outsourcing involving storage/access to customer data, require outsourcing operators/service providers to comply with bank's data security/leakage policies and procedures including listed controls and NDA; effective monitoring/validation; clear contract requirements; regular assessment.
controls.full_text: For outsourcing arrangements that involve storage of and/or access to bank' customer data, the bank shall require their outsourcing operators and other service providers which store, transport or have access to customer data to comply with the bank' data security, data leakage policies and procedures, including the controls set out in this document and signing non-disclosure agreement. The bank shall ensure that effective controls are enforced to monitor and validate the service provider's compliance with the said controls. Such requirements shall be specified clearly in the agreements and the bank shall conduct a regular assessment to ensure that the service providers comply with all relevant requirements and audit.
evidence_requirements: Outsourcing agreements with data security clauses

controls.title: Documented migration policy and methodology
controls.description: Define and document migration policy specifying plan and methodology for data migration verifying completeness, consistency and integrity of data and processes during migration.
controls.full_text: The bank shall define and document a migration policy specifying migration plan and methodology for data migration to verify completeness, consistency and integrity of data and processes during migration of the data

controls.title: Pre/post migration activities, responsibilities, timelines
controls.description: Policy lists pre- and post-migration activities along with responsibilities and timelines for activities.
controls.full_text: The policy shall also list down pre- and post-migration activities along with responsibilities and timelines for activities.
evidence_requirements: Migration runbook with timelines and owners

controls.title: Explicit sign-off at each migration stage
controls.description: Explicit sign off must be obtained from users/application owners after each stage of migration and after completion of the migration process.
controls.full_text: Explicit sign off must be obtained from users/application owners after each stage of migration and after completion of the migration process.

controls.title: Audit trails for migration conversion
controls.description: Audit trail/logs available to document the conversion, including data mappings and transformations.
controls.full_text: Audit trail/logs must be available to document the conversion, including data mappings and transformations.

controls.title: Access rights for archived privileged information
controls.description: Data retention and archival policy defines appropriate access rights to prevent unauthorized access to archived privileged info avoiding compromise of C-I-A.
controls.full_text: The data retention and archival policy must define appropriate access rights to prevent any unauthorized access to archived privileged information in order to avoid any compromise of confidentiality, integrity and accessibility of the said information.
evidence_requirements: Data retention/archival policy with access rights

controls.title: Integrity tools for hosted info; backup/archival/recovery procedures preserving I/C
controls.description: Preserve integrity of info hosted on respective environments/media by implementing file/data integrity tools; backup, archival and recovery processes have corresponding procedures ensuring integrity and confidentiality of data is retained.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that integrity of information hosted on respective environments/media is preserved by implementing file/data integrity tools. Processes for backup, archival and recovery of data must have corresponding procedures which ensure that the integrity and confidentiality of the data is retained.

controls.title: 15-year financial info retention; align with Data Privacy Protection Law
controls.description: Policy documents archival frequency and retention periods of information assets including critical info under regulatory/legislative requirements; financial information transactions/track records retained at least 15 years; data archival and retention aligned with Data Privacy Protection Law personal information handling.
controls.full_text: The policy must document and determine the archival frequency and retention periods of information assets including but not limited to the critical information that they hold governed by compliance to regulatory and legislative requirements. The bank must ensure that the financial information transactions or track records are retained for at least 15 years. Additionally, it must be ensured that data archival and retention periods must be in line with the requirements for handling personal information as specified in the Data Privacy Protection Law.

controls.title: MDM with containerization for corporate data
controls.description: Implement Mobile Device Management (MDM) bringing containerization aspect to ensure only components of corporate data are encrypted and not the entire personal device.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement a mobile device management (MDM) solution that will bring in the aspect of containerization to ensure that only components of corporate data is encrypted and not the entire personal device.

controls.title: BYOD policy for personal devices
controls.description: Define Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policy on usage of Personal Devices (PDs) in the bank's environment.
controls.full_text: A Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policy shall be defined by the bank on the usage of Personal Devices (PDs) in the bank's environment.

controls.title: BYOD security guidelines for PDs
controls.description: Formulate BYOD guidelines per data classification and risk assessment policies covering data security, storage, system recovery and training; minimum requirements: PDs encrypted/password-protected and supervised, not in high-risk areas without approval; non-compliant PDs not connected; managed same as bank-owned; firewalls/IPS/monitoring for PDs; guests on segregated network; remote wipe/emergency lock on loss/theft.
controls.full_text: The bank shall formulate these guidelines in accordance with their data classification and risk assessment policies. These shall cover areas such as data security, data storage, system recovery and training. At minimum, the bank shall ensure the below mentioned guidelines are followed regarding the security of personal devices (PDs): a. PDs must be encrypted and password protected to secure the information they store. Additionally, they must be kept under supervision when not in use. PDs shall not be allowed into environments such as high risk areas without prior approval from the Information Security team/department. b. PDs which do not comply with the BYOD policy shall not be allowed to connect to the bank's network. Additionally, PDs shall be managed and accounted in the same manner as bank owned devices. c. Measures such as deployment of firewalls, IPS and monitoring systems shall be undertaken for protection of PD's. d. If there is a guest, they should be connected to a segregated network. e. In case of loss or theft of the PDs, incident management procedures shall be followed, as per bank's policies. Additionally, it must be ensured that remote wipe/or emergency lock features are enabled for PDs.

controls.title: Risk assessment per asset for threat/vulnerability pairs
controls.description: Formulate and enforce risk assessment and management controls for each asset to identify threat/vulnerability combinations impacting confidentiality, availability or integrity from business/compliance/contractual perspective.
controls.full_text: The bank shall formulate and enforce risk assessment and management controls, for each asset, to identify the threat/vulnerability combinations that have the likelihood of impacting the confidentiality, availability or integrity of that asset - from a business, compliance or contractual perspective.

controls.title: Annual gap analysis and risk assessment
controls.description: Perform annual gap analysis and risk assessment to determine if current controls adequate and response/recovery plans effective; put roadmap to promptly address any gaps.
controls.full_text: An annual gap analysis and risk assessment shall be performed to determine if the current controls are adequate, and their response and recovery plans are effective. Additionally, the bank shall put a roadmap in place to promptly address any gaps that are found.

controls.title: Risk assessment program minimum contents
controls.description: Risk assessment program shall include: asset identification and valuation; control effectiveness evaluation; ensuring cost-effective protection; threat assessment (nature, war, accidents, malicious acts); vulnerability assessment with exploit probability covering policies/procedures/standards/trainings/physical security/QC/technical security; business/operational/financial impact analysis (qualitative or quantitative); threat & vulnerability matrix for prioritization.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that the risk assessment program must contain, at a minimum: a. Asset identification and estimation of their value: Identifying, selecting and implementing controls for providing proportional response including considerations like productivity, cost effectiveness and the value of the asset. b. Evaluating the effectiveness of the control measures. c. Ensuring the controls provide the required cost-effective protection. d. A threat assessment that shall include aspects such as acts of nature, acts of war, accidents, malicious acts originating from inside or outside the organization. e. A vulnerability assessment for each vulnerability and calculating the probability that it will be exploited. Additionally, policies, procedures, standards, trainings, physical security, quality control and technical security shall also be evaluated. f. Following risk identification, the bank shall calculate the business, operational and financial impact analysis that each threat would have on each asset through qualitative or quantitative analysis. The extent of risk impact depends on the likelihood of the various threat and vulnerability pairings or linkages capable of causing harm to the organization when an adverse event occurs. g. The bank shall develop a threat and vulnerability matrix to assess the impact of the threat to its IT environment and will also assist in prioritizing IT risks.

controls.title: Risk acknowledgement and acceptance process
controls.description: Senior management establishes function to implement/manage risk management; risk management function formulates formal technology risk acknowledgement and acceptance process for reviewing/evaluating/approving major non-compliance with IT control policies; include risk assessment/description, mitigating controls, remedial plan, owner and senior management approval.
controls.full_text: Senior management must establish clearly a function for implementing and managing the risk management process. Accordingly, the risk management function (team, committee, etc.) shall formulate a formal technology risk acknowledgement and acceptance process for reviewing, evaluating and approving any major incidents of non-compliance with IT control policies. The process shall include at a minimum: a. Risk assessment and description being considered for acknowledgement by the risk owner. b. Identification of mitigating controls. c. Formulation of a remedial plan to reduce the risk d. Approval of the risk acknowledgement from the risk owner and senior management.
evidence_requirements: Sample risk acceptance records with owner and senior management approval

controls.title: Risk identification categories and biannual gap analysis
controls.description: Identify events/activities disrupting operations or affecting reputation/earnings and assess regulatory compliance; categories: strategic failures (improper implementation, supplier failure, requirements, incompatibility, regulatory compliance); design failures (project mgmt, cost/time overrun, programming errors, data migration); transition failures (capacity planning, availability requirements, SLA/OLA, security breaches); biannual gap analysis to determine adequacy and effectiveness of controls, with roadmap.
controls.full_text: As a part of risk identification and assessment, the bank must identify events or activities that could disrupt operations, or negatively affect the reputation or earnings, and assess compliance to regulatory requirements. Risks identified can be broadly categorized into the following categories: a. Strategic failures: This may include improper implementation, failure of supplier, inappropriate definition of requirements, incompatibility with existing application infrastructure etc. It will also include regulatory compliance. b. Design failures: This may include inadequate project management, cost and time overruns, programming errors and data migration failures among others. c. Transition failures: This may include inadequate capacity planning, inappropriately defined availability requirements, SLA/OLA/Underpinning contracts not appropriately defined and information security breaches, among others. Biannual gap analysis and risk assessments shall be performed to determine if the current controls are adequate, and their response and recovery plans are effective. Additionally, the bank shall put in place a roadmap to promptly address any gaps that are found.

controls.title: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
controls.description: Deploy WAF for securing applications in the infrastructure.
controls.full_text: Web Application Firewall (WAF) shall be deployed for securing applications in the infrastructure.

controls.title: Application security testing of web/mobile apps
controls.description: Conduct application security testing of web/mobile applications throughout lifecycle (pre-implementation, post implementation and post any major changes); share reports with stakeholders and track to closure.
controls.full_text: The bank shall conduct application security testing of web/mobile applications throughout their lifecycle (pre-implementation, post implementation and post any major changes). The reports shall be shared with stakeholders and tracked to closure.
evidence_requirements: AppSec testing reports per lifecycle stage

controls.title: Bi-annual VA, code reviews and pen testing for application infrastructure
controls.description: Perform vulnerability assessments, code reviews and penetration testing at a minimum of two, or more frequently as needed, on an annual basis for entire application infrastructure.
controls.full_text: The bank shall also perform vulnerability assessments, code reviews and penetration testing at a minimum of two, or more frequently as needed, on an annual basis for the entire application infrastructure.

controls.title: Secure application development guidelines
controls.description: Formulate secure application development guidelines in accordance with industry standards OWASP, CERT secure code, MITRE CWE.
controls.full_text: The bank shall formulate secure application development guidelines in accordance with industry standards such as Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP), CERT secure code standards and MITRE CWE standards.
evidence_requirements: Secure coding standards document referencing OWASP/CERT/CWE

controls.title: Information protection in web applications per cryptographic guidelines
controls.description: Information at rest, in motion and in use in web applications secured per cryptographic security section guidelines.
controls.full_text: Information while at rest, in motion and in use in web applications shall be secured as per the guidelines outlined in the cryptographic security section.

controls.title: Bi-annual comprehensive vulnerability assessment
controls.description: Deploy combination of automated tools and manual techniques for comprehensive VA exercise minimum twice or more frequently as needed annually; follow industry practices/standards (OWASP, OSSTMM, SANS); compare results to previous scans to verify vulnerabilities addressed.
controls.full_text: The bank shall deploy a combination of automated tools and manual techniques to perform a comprehensive Vulnerability Assessment (VA) exercise at a minimum of two, or more frequently as needed, on an annual basis. Industry practices and standards shall be followed for performing these tests, such as OWASP, OSSTMM, SANS. At a minimum, the bank must compare the results from previous vulnerability scans to verify that these vulnerabilities were addressed and mitigated.

controls.title: Action plan shared with senior management
controls.description: Prepare action plan to address identified vulnerabilities and share with senior management.
controls.full_text: An action plan to address identified vulnerabilities shall be prepared and shared with the senior management.

controls.title: Bi-annual penetration testing exercises
controls.description: Conduct two penetration testing exercises or more frequently as needed on annual basis.
controls.full_text: The bank shall conduct two penetration testing exercises, or more frequently as needed, on an annual basis.
evidence_requirements: Pen test schedule and execution reports (2+/year)

controls.title: Semi-annual review of accepted business risks
controls.description: Acceptance of business risks for existing vulnerabilities reviewed semi-annually to determine if more recent controls/patches can address previously accepted vulnerabilities or if conditions have changed increasing the risk.
controls.full_text: Acceptance of business risks for existing vulnerabilities shall be reviewed semi-annually to determine if more recent controls or patches can address vulnerabilities that were previously accepted, or if conditions have changed increasing the risk.

controls.title: Domain protection and monitoring services
controls.description: Protect domains against agents registering similar domain names for malicious purposes; procure domain monitoring services to monitor recent registrations and highlight deceptive similar domains.
controls.full_text: The domains shall be protected to provide recourse against an agent who register similar domain names for malicious purposes. Additionally, the bank must procure domain monitoring services that monitor recent domain registrations and highlight them if a deceptive domain is being registered similar to their domain.

controls.title: Hardened email/DNS with SPF, DKIM, digital signing
controls.description: Email servers and DNS hardened per best practices such as SPF, DKIM and digital signing to prevent phishing.
controls.full_text: Email servers and DNS must be hardened as per best practices such as Sender Policy Framework (SPF), Domain Keys Identified Mail (DKIM) and digital signing will be followed to prevent phishing.

controls.title: Customer phishing awareness and reporting channel; QCB notification
controls.description: Educate customers via notification and awareness on phishing/suspicious emails; provide email address (spoofmail@bank.com) for customers to submit suspicious emails for authentication determination; inform QCB about discovery of all phishing incidents.
controls.full_text: The bank should educate their customers through customer notification and awareness with regards to phishing emails and suspicious emails. The bank must provide an email address, such as spoofmail@bank.com, to which the customers can submit a suspicious email to determine its authenticity. The bank must inform QCB about the discovery of all phishing incidents.

controls.title: Phishing evidence preservation
controls.description: Preserve evidence of phishing attacks for subsequent prosecution of phishers if such recourse is taken.
controls.full_text: The bank shall preserve the evidence of phishing attacks for subsequent prosecution of the phishers if such a recourse is taken.

controls.title: Anti-malware controls at host, network and user level
controls.description: Formulate and enforce controls to detect and mitigate malware at host, network and user level.
controls.full_text: The bank shall formulate and enforce controls to detect and mitigate malware at host, network and user level.

controls.title: Anti-malware software and signature updates
controls.description: Keep anti-malware software and signatures up to date.
controls.full_text: The bank must keep their anti-malware software and signature up to date.

controls.title: Disable auto-run; automated scan of removable media
controls.description: Disable auto run functionality on laptops, workstations and servers; perform automated anti-malware scan of removable media when inserted into system.
controls.full_text: Auto run functionality shall be disabled on laptops, workstations and servers. Additionally, an automated anti-malware scan of removable media must be performed when inserted into the system.

controls.title: Email attachment filtering at gateway
controls.description: Filter attachments at the email gateway.
controls.full_text: The bank must filter attachments at the email gateway.

controls.title: Daily monitoring of firewall/IPS/IDS/DNS/proxy logs
controls.description: Logs from firewalls, IPS/IDS, DNS servers and proxy server logs must be monitored on a daily basis for indicators of compromise.
controls.full_text: Logs from firewalls, IPS/IDS, DNS servers and proxy server logs must be monitored on a daily basis for indicators of compromise.

controls.title: Identify DoS/DDoS bottlenecks and SPOF
controls.description: Identify potential bottlenecks and single points of failure vulnerable to DoS/DDoS attacks via network design analysis and configuration testing.
controls.full_text: The bank shall identify potential bottlenecks and single points of failure which can be vulnerable to DOS/DDoS attacks. This could be identified by performing network design analysis and configuration testing.

controls.title: DoS/DDoS considered in ISP selection (app + volumetric)
controls.description: Consider DoS/DDoS attacks in ISP application and volumetric layer selection process.
controls.full_text: The bank must consider DOS/DDoS attacks in their ISP on application and volumetric layer selection process.

controls.title: Periodically validated DDoS incident response framework
controls.description: Formulate incident response framework periodically validated to facilitate fast response to DoS/DDoS attack.
controls.full_text: The bank shall formulate an incident response framework which shall be periodically validated to facilitate a fast response to a DOS/DDoS attack.

controls.title: IPS at internal and external level
controls.description: IPS capabilities shall be present at both internal and external level.
controls.full_text: IPS capabilities shall be present at both internal and external level.

controls.title: Monitoring of servers/network/endpoint for suspicious activities
controls.description: Monitor suspicious activities on servers, network and endpoint devices; mechanisms to detect, alert and block anomalies on affected devices.
controls.full_text: The bank must monitor suspicious activities on servers, network and endpoint devices. Mechanisms shall be deployed to detect, alert and block anomalies on the affected devices.

controls.title: Network traffic baseline and anomaly response
controls.description: Define network traffic baseline by analysing network traffic; any deviations or anomalies treated as priority.
controls.full_text: A network traffic baseline must be defined by the bank by analyzing network traffic, and any deviations or anomalies must be taken up as a priority.

controls.title: Cyber-breach response plan in IR framework
controls.description: Incident response framework must include cyber-breach response plan measuring details on countering cyber intrusions.
controls.full_text: The incident response framework must include a cyber-breach response plan that measures details on countering cyber intrusions.

controls.title: Thorough investigation of cyber intrusion
controls.description: In event of cyber-intrusion, perform thorough investigation to determine extent of infiltration, impact sustained and vulnerabilities exploited.
controls.full_text: In the event of a cyber-intrusion, the bank must perform a thorough investigation to determine the extent of infiltration and the impact sustained, as well as the vulnerabilities being exploited by the attacker.

controls.title: Physical space zoning by security requirements
controls.description: Zone physical spaces depending on security requirements; requirements for each separated zone determined through risk assessment during design phase of new construction or as part of ongoing risk mgmt for existing workplaces.
controls.full_text: Physical spaces shall be zoned depending upon their security requirements. The requirements for each physically separated zone must be determined through a risk assessment. This must be done during the design phase of a new construction or, for existing workplaces, as part of an on-going risk management process.

controls.title: Environmental monitoring controls
controls.description: Implement physical and environmental controls to monitor conditions affecting operation of info processing facilities (fire, explosives, smoke, temperature, water, dust).
controls.full_text: Physical and environmental controls must be implemented to monitor environmental conditions which could affect the operation of information processing facilities (e.g. fire, explosives, smoke, temperature, water and dust).

controls.title: UPS and backup generator
controls.description: Equipment and facilities protected from power failures and electrical supply interference by installing UPS and backup generator.
controls.full_text: Equipment and facilities shall be protected from power failures and electrical supply interference by, for example, installing Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) and a backup generator.

controls.title: Physical security barriers for computer facilities
controls.description: Protect computer facilities/equipment from damage and unauthorized access through physical security: security barriers and entry controls for data centers, card and pin generation facilities; access restricted to authorized personnel and reviewed periodically; buildings give minimum indication of purpose with no obvious signs identifying info processing facilities.
controls.full_text: Computer facilities and equipment shall be protected from damage and unauthorized access through physical security controls, including: a. Security barriers and entry controls must be deployed to protect information processing facilities such as data centers, card and pin generation facilities. b. Access to these areas must be restricted to authorized personnel and the access rights must be reviewed and updated periodically. c. Buildings must give a minimum indication of their purpose, with no obvious signs identifying the presence of information processing facilities.
evidence_requirements: Security barrier/entry control evidence (DC, PIN room)

controls.title: Vendor/contractor/guest physical access in line with policy
controls.description: Access control policies and approval processes in line with access control section; vendors, contractors, delegates or guests visiting bank premises adhere to physical and access control policy.
controls.full_text: Access control policies and approval processes must be in line with instructions specified in the access control section. It must be ensured that vendors, contractors, delegates or guests visiting bank premises adhere to the bank's physical and access control policy.

controls.title: Site security plan and SOPs
controls.description: Formulate site security plan and SOPs for secure areas covering: security risk assessment summary; org chart with facility officer and staff roles; admin/operation/maintenance of electronic access control system and security alarm system; key management, enrolment/removal of system users and personal identification issuing; staff clearances, awareness training, periodic briefings; audit trail/log inspection; end-of-day checks and lockup; ICT security incident and breach reporting.
controls.full_text: The bank shall formulate a site security plan and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for secure areas. The site security plan shall cover the following, at a minimum: a. Summary of the security risk assessment. b. Organization chart detailing upon roles and responsibilities of the facility officer and staff. c. The administration, operation and maintenance of the electronic access control system and security alarm system. d. Key management, the enrolment and removal of system users and issuing of personal identification. e. Staff member clearances, security awareness training and periodic briefings. f. Inspection of the generated audit trails and logs. g. End of day checks and lockup. h. Reporting of ICT security incidents and breaches.

controls.title: Monitoring of environmental controls and service availability
controls.description: Deploy monitoring mechanisms for detection of compromises of environmental controls such as temperature, water, smoke, access alarms, service availability alerts (power supply, telecommunication, servers) and access log reviews.
controls.full_text: The bank must deploy monitoring mechanisms for the detection of compromises of environmental controls such as temperature, water, smoke, access alarms, service availability alerts (power supply, telecommunication, servers) and access log reviews.

controls.title: Cryptographic policy with internationally recognised algorithms
controls.description: Define cryptographic policy referring to industry standards; select encryption algorithms which are well-established international standards subjected to rigorous scrutiny by international cryptographer community or approved by authoritative professional body, reputable security vendor or government agency.
controls.full_text: The bank must define their cryptographic policy by referring to industry standards. The bank shall select encryption algorithms which are well established international standards, and which have been subjected to rigorous scrutiny by the international cryptographer community or approved by an authoritative professional body, reputable security vendor or government agency.

controls.title: Key management standards (ISO 11770) covering full lifecycle
controls.description: Define and adhere to key management standards such as ISO 11770-1 to control/manage cryptographic key lifecycle covering: custodians roles/responsibilities; key generation; dual control and split knowledge; secure key storage; key usage; secure key distribution and in transit; key backup and recovery; periodic key status checking; key compromise; key revocation and destruction; audit trails and documentation; key lifetime determined by application and information infrastructure utilized.
controls.full_text: The bank must define and adhere to key management standards, such as ISO11770 - 1, to control and manage the lifecycle of cryptographic keys. At minimum, the key management standard must cover the following requirements: a. key custodians roles and responsibilities b. key generation c. dual control and split knowledge d. secure key storage e. key usage f. secure key distribution and in transit g. key backup and recovery h. periodic key status checking i. key compromise j. key revocation and destruction k. audit trails and documentation. Additionally, it must be ensured that the lifetime of the key management standards shall be determined by the application and the information infrastructure it is utilized within.

controls.title: Encryption protection of confidential info at rest/transit/use
controls.description: Ensure confidential info integrity by encryption; protect against unauthorized disclosure in transit, at rest and in use; risk assessment determines info asset criticality and cryptographic control formulation.
controls.full_text: Integrity of confidential information shall be ensured by encryption and by ensuring protection against unauthorized disclosure in transit, at rest and in use. Risk assessment must be performed to determine information asset criticality and formulation of cryptographic controls.

controls.title: Practices for securing confidential data with various crypto methods
controls.description: Follow practices to secure confidential data at rest, in transit or in use such as securing web traffic, file transfers, remote access, emails, secure data hashing, HDD/data-at-rest encryption, symmetric key encryption, asymmetric key encryption and hardware security modules (HSMs).
controls.full_text: Practices shall be followed for securing confidential data at rest, in transit or in use, such as securing web traffic, file transfers, remote access, emails, secure data hashing, HDD/data at rest encryption, symmetric key encryption, asymmetric key encryption and hardware security modules (HSM's) etc.
evidence_requirements: Encryption practices inventory (TLS, SFTP, S/MIME, FDE, etc.)

controls.title: Password protection at rest/in transit; privileged password encryption and offsite backup
controls.description: Passwords secured/protected against unauthorized disclosure at rest or in transit; privileged passwords encrypted and stored offsite with backup files each time password changed to ensure complete recovery.
controls.full_text: Passwords shall be secured and protected against unauthorized disclosure at rest or in transit. Additionally, privileged passwords must be encrypted and stored off-site with backup files each time the password is changed to ensure complete recovery.
evidence_requirements: Privileged password vault with offsite backup

controls.title: HSM for key management and cryptographic processing
controls.description: Implement Hardware Security Module (HSM) for key management and cryptographic processing to ensure cryptographic functions are appropriately randomized and secured.
controls.full_text: To ensure cryptographic functions are appropriately randomized and secured, a Hardware Security Module (HSM) must be implemented for key management and cryptographic processing.

controls.title: State-licensed digital certificates with online revocation
controls.description: Use state-licensed and approved digital certificates in production system; ensure compliance to CSP-PMA, MICT standards; use online revocation mechanisms to curb fraudulent use of digital certificates.
controls.full_text: State licensed and approved digital certificates shall be used in the bank production system. The bank shall ensure that the digital certificates are compliant to standards in use by the CSP-PMA, MICT. Online revocation mechanisms shall be used to curb the risk of fraudulent use of digital certificates.

controls.title: Secure SDLC aligned to OWASP/CERT/CWE
controls.description: Formulate secure application development guidelines (S-SDLC) per industry standards OWASP, CERT secure code, MITRE CWE to create secure web applications and web services.
controls.full_text: The bank shall formulate secure application development guidelines (S-SDLC) in accordance with industry standards such as Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP), CERT secure code standards and MITRE CWE standards to create secure web applications and web services.

controls.title: Isolated test/development environments
controls.description: Test and development environments isolated from production systems; access to these systems granted to authorized users with clear business requirement.
controls.full_text: It must be ensured that test and development environments are isolated from production systems. Access to these systems shall be granted to authorized users with a clear business requirement.

controls.title: Application classification per National Information Classification Policy
controls.description: Internally developed or externally procured applications classified per the National Information Classification Policy.
controls.full_text: Internally developed or externally procured applications must be classified as per the National Information Classification Policy.

controls.title: Source code review for coding/security vulnerabilities
controls.description: Perform source code review to find vulnerabilities from coding issues, poor coding practices or malicious attempts.
controls.full_text: The bank must perform a source code review to find vulnerabilities arising due to coding issues, poor coding practices or malicious attempts.

controls.title: Source code acquisition or escrow for custom critical apps
controls.description: Source code of custom developed critical applications acquired; if not possible, look at options of arranging an escrow for source code.
controls.full_text: The source code of custom developed critical applications should be acquired by the bank. If this is not possible, the bank look into options of arranging an escrow for the source code.

controls.title: Security requirements in system requirements specifications
controls.description: Security requirements (functional, technical and assurance) developed and implemented as part of system requirements specifications.
controls.full_text: Security requirements (functional, technical and assurance requirements) shall be developed and implemented as a part of system requirements specifications.
evidence_requirements: SRS documents with security requirements section

controls.title: Application review for external connections
controls.description: Review applications to determine whether they attempt to establish any external connections.
controls.full_text: Applications must be reviewed to determine whether they attempt to establish any external connections.

controls.title: Integrity checks on backup info; replica environment; secure storage of integrity info
controls.description: Perform integrity checks on backup information to identify compromise or legitimate but incorrectly completed system modification; perform checks on replica environment; securely store integrity information on different server and update after every legitimate change of system or application.
controls.full_text: Integrity checks must be performed on the backup information to identify if a compromise, or a legitimate but incorrectly completed system modification, has occurred. Additionally, these checks shall be performed on a replica environment. Integrity information must be securely stored on a different server and must be updated after every legitimate change of system or application.

controls.title: High-risk servers in DMZ
controls.description: High risk servers (web, email, file, IP telephony servers having connectivity to public networks) must be hosted in a DMZ.
controls.full_text: High risk servers, e.g. web, email, file and Internet Protocol telephony servers having connectivity to public networks, must be hosted in a DMZ.

controls.title: Resolve undocumented changes via incident management
controls.description: Resolve any undocumented changes in accordance with bank's internal security incident management procedures.
controls.full_text: Any undocumented changes must be resolved in accordance with the bank's internal security incident management procedures.

controls.title: Assessment of office utility software macros/scripts
controls.description: Perform assessment to ascertain importance of office utility software; some business applications provide functionality to create macros and simple applications to automate operations.
controls.full_text: The bank must perform an assessment to ascertain the importance of office utility software, and some business applications provide the functionality to create macros and simple applications to automate operations.

controls.title: Policy/procedure to review/test user-developed macros and scripts
controls.description: Formulate policy/procedure to review and test user-developed macros and scripts before use to ensure integrity and reliability of applications.
controls.full_text: The bank shall formulate a policy/procedure to review and test user-developed macros and scripts before they are used to ensure the integrity and reliability of the applications.

controls.title: Media classification per contained information
controls.description: Hardware or media classified according to information contained in the media; security controls deployed to protect media.
controls.full_text: The hardware or media shall be classified according to the information contained in the media. The bank shall ensure that security controls are deployed to protect the media.

controls.title: Visual identifiable classification labelling
controls.description: Classification of all media must be visually identifiable; labelling scheme documented and uniformly applied across the organization; media protected against tampering.
controls.full_text: Classification of all media must be visually identifiable, and the labelling scheme be documented and uniformly applied across the organization, and such media should be protected against tampering.

controls.title: Media sanitization process with tested tools
controls.description: Define process and procedures for media sanitization; identify and adopt tools; testing conducted at regular intervals to ensure effectiveness of the tool.
controls.full_text: The bank shall define the process and procedures for sanitization of media and identify and adopt tools to meet the requirements. Testing shall be conducted at regular intervals to ensure effectiveness of the tool.
