controls.category: Media sanitization, repairing, maintenance, destruction and disposal

controls.title: Authorized personnel for media repair/maintenance
controls.description: Only authorized personnel carry out repairs and maintenance work on classified media.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that only authorized personnel carry out repairs and maintenance work on classified media.
controls.category: Media sanitization, repairing, maintenance, destruction and disposal

controls.title: Documented destruction and disposal procedures
controls.description: Document procedures for the destruction and disposal of media.
controls.full_text: The bank shall document procedures for the destruction and disposal of media.
controls.category: Media sanitization, repairing, maintenance, destruction and disposal

controls.title: Degaussing and physical destruction (smashing, drilling)
controls.description: Destroy media by degaussing non-volatile media and physically destroying media through smashing and drilling.
controls.full_text: Media shall be destroyed by degaussing non-volatile media and physically destroying media through smashing and drilling.
controls.category: Media sanitization, repairing, maintenance, destruction and disposal

controls.title: Supervised destruction with due diligence
controls.description: Staff members supervise destruction of media; due diligence carried out during destruction.
controls.full_text: Staff members shall supervise the destruction of media and that due diligence is carried out during the destruction of the media.
controls.category: Media sanitization, repairing, maintenance, destruction and disposal

controls.title: Discreet media/waste disposal preventing dumpster diving
controls.description: Disposal of media/media waste shall not attract undue attention possibly leading to dumpster diving attempts by malicious users.
controls.full_text: It will be ensured that the disposal of the media and media waste does not attract undue attention, which may possibly lead to attempts by malicious users to dumpster diving.
controls.category: Media sanitization, repairing, maintenance, destruction and disposal

controls.title: Sanitize faulty/classified media before disposal
controls.description: Media including faulty media containing classified information completely sanitized as much as possible prior to disposal.
controls.full_text: It must be ensured that media, including faulty media, containing classified information is completely sanitized as much as possible prior to disposal.
controls.category: Media sanitization, repairing, maintenance, destruction and disposal

controls.title: Contracts with third-party disposal firms
controls.description: Contracts with third party disposal firms must address acceptable disposal procedures.
controls.full_text: Contracts with third party disposal firms must address acceptable disposal procedures.
controls.category: Media sanitization, repairing, maintenance, destruction and disposal
evidence_requirements: Third-party disposal contracts with required procedures

controls.title: Resilient and physically secured data centre
controls.description: Ensure data centre(s) resilient and physically secured from internal and external threats.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that the data center(s) is resilient and physically secured from internal and external threats.

controls.title: Threat assessment of DC perimeter and surroundings
controls.description: Include in scope of threat vulnerability risk assessment a review of each data centre's perimeter and surrounding environment, as well as building and facilities.
controls.full_text: The bank shall include in the scope of threat vulnerability risk assessment a review of each data centers perimeter and surrounding environment, as well as building and facilities.
evidence_requirements: DC perimeter and surroundings threat assessment

controls.title: Redundancy and fault tolerance assessment
controls.description: Assess redundancy and fault tolerance in areas such as electrical power, air conditioning, fire suppression and data communications.
controls.full_text: The bank shall assess the redundancy and fault tolerance in areas such as electrical power, air conditioning, fire suppression and data communications.

controls.title: Fire protection and suppression systems
controls.description: Implement appropriate fire protection and suppression systems.
controls.full_text: The bank must implement appropriate fire protection and suppression systems.

controls.title: UPS, battery arrays and diesel generators
controls.description: Uninterruptible backup power and power supplies, battery arrays and/or diesel generators installed at each data centre.
controls.full_text: It must be ensured that an uninterruptible backup power and power supplies, battery arrays and/or diesel generators are installed at each data center.

controls.title: Restrict DC access to authorized staff
controls.description: Restrict access to data centre to authorized staff only.
controls.full_text: The bank shall restrict access to the data center to authorized staff only.

controls.title: Immediate access revocation when no longer required
controls.description: Physical access of staff to data centre revoked immediately if no longer required.
controls.full_text: Physical access of staff to the data center shall be revoked immediately if it is no longer required.

controls.title: Non-bank personnel temporary access with notification and escort
controls.description: For non-bank personnel (vendors/system administrators) requiring temporary DC access, ensure proper notification and approval; visitors accompanied at all times by authorized employee while in data centre.
controls.full_text: For non-bank personnel, such as vendors or system administrators who require temporary access to the data center to perform maintenance or repair work, the bank shall ensure that there is proper notification of and approval for such visits. The bank shall ensure that visitors are accompanied at all times by an authorized employee while in the data center.

controls.title: Physical security of DC perimeter, building, facility and equipment room
controls.description: Ensure perimeter of data centre, building, facility and equipment room is physically secured and monitored.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that the perimeter of the data center, the data center building, facility and equipment room is physically secured and monitored.

controls.title: Physical, human and procedural controls
controls.description: Employ physical, human and procedural controls.
controls.full_text: The bank shall employ physical, human and procedural controls

controls.title: Security systems and surveillance to monitor and record DC activities
controls.description: Deploy security systems and surveillance tools where appropriate to monitor and record activities taking place within the data centre.
controls.full_text: The bank shall deploy security systems and surveillance tools, where appropriate, to monitor and record activities that takes place within the data center.
evidence_requirements: DC CCTV / access control deployment with recording retention

controls.title: Physical security against unauthorised access to systems/MFDs/racks/tapes
controls.description: Establish physical security measures to prevent unauthorized access to systems, multi-functional devices, equipment, racks and tapes.
controls.full_text: The bank shall establish physical security measures to prevent unauthorized access to systems, multi-functional devices, equipment, racks and tapes.

controls.title: Board and senior management governance of outsourced processes
controls.description: Board of directors and senior management responsible for governance, compliance and risk management of outsourced processes; set proper framework to ensure service quality as if bank provided services itself.
controls.full_text: The board of directors and bank senior management shall be responsible for the governance, compliance and risk management of outsourced processes, and they must set the proper framework to ensure quality of services provided as if the bank were to provide these services by itself.

controls.title: Prior QCB approval for outsourcing service providers
controls.description: Bank seeking to use services of outsourcing service providers must seek prior approval of QCB before entering into any agreements; scope of service submitted to QCB for approval.
controls.full_text: A bank seeking to use the services of any of the outsourcing service providers must seek prior approval of QCB before entering into any agreements for such services, and the scope of service to be outsourced shall be submitted to QCB for approval.

controls.title: Risk assessment, due diligence and jurisdiction clarification
controls.description: Perform thorough risk assessment and due diligence to formulate appropriate mitigating controls for service providers; clarify jurisdiction for data and applicable regulations at outset of outsourcing arrangement.
controls.full_text: A thorough risk assessment and due diligence exercise must be performed to formulate appropriate mitigating controls of service providers. Additionally, the bank must clarify jurisdiction for their data and applicable regulations at the outset of an outsourcing arrangement.

controls.title: Formal contract of service
controls.description: Formalize any work area to be outsourced to third party by contract of service.
controls.full_text: The bank shall formalize any work area to be outsourced to a third party by a contract of service.
evidence_requirements: Signed service contracts for outsourced work areas

controls.title: Approval requirement for significant subcontracting
controls.description: Outsourcing arrangement must include approval requirement for significant subcontracting of services and provisions by original technology service provider.
controls.full_text: The outsourcing arrangement must include an approval requirement for significant subcontracting of services and provisions by the original technology service provider.
evidence_requirements: Subcontracting approval clause in outsourcing contract

controls.title: Right-to-audit by internal/external auditors and QCB examiners
controls.description: Outsourcing agreements include provisions outlining right to audit service providers by internal or external auditor and QCB examiners.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that outsourcing agreements include the provisions outlining the right to audit service providers by internal or external auditor and QCB examiners.

controls.title: ISAE reports from outsourcing/remote service provider
controls.description: Ensure ISAE standard reports on assurance of controls required from outsourcing vendor or remote service provider.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure International Standards on Assurance Engagements (ISAE) standard reports on assurance of controls are required from the outsourcing vendor or remote service provider.
evidence_requirements: ISAE 3402 / similar reports from outsourcing providers

controls.title: Continuous monitoring of 3P reports and SLA audits
controls.description: Reports provided by third party service provider continuously monitored and reviewed; audits conducted to ensure adherence to SLAs.
controls.full_text: The reports provided by third party service provider shall be continuously monitored and reviewed, and audits conducted to ensure adherence to SLA's.

controls.title: Encrypted/protected remote third-party access
controls.description: When third-party services provided by remote access, ensure communication channels are encrypted or protected end-to-end through latest secure mechanisms.
controls.full_text: In case third party services are provided by using remote access, the bank shall ensure that communication channels are encrypted or protected end to end through the latest secure mechanisms.

controls.title: 3P change management and test-environment work
controls.description: Third party vendors and technology outsourcing companies subjected to bank's change management for any changes to software, program or application source code; third party developers work only in test environment.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that third party vendors and technology outsourcing companies are subjected to the bank's change management for any changes to software, program or application source code. In addition to this, it must be ensured that third party developers work only in a test environment.

controls.title: Develop in-house technology skillsets as contingency
controls.description: Develop technology skillset among relevant team members in areas being outsourced as a contingency measure.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure it develops the technology skillset among relevant team members etc. that is being outsourced to technology outsourcing companies as a contingency measure.
evidence_requirements: Internal skills development plan covering outsourced functions

controls.title: Access to application source code developed by third party
controls.description: Ensure no legal obstacles to access and obtain application source code developed by third party; such clauses specified in any outsourcing agreement.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that there are no legal obstacles to access and obtain the application source code developed by the third party and such clauses shall be specified in any outsourcing agreement.
evidence_requirements: Source code access clauses in outsourcing contracts

controls.title: Regular security and incident reporting by third party
controls.description: Third party contractually required to regularly report on outsourced service security posture and incidents.
controls.full_text: The third party shall be contractually required to regularly report on the outsourced service security posture and incidents.

controls.title: Provider-site measures for normal operation in exceptional events
controls.description: Ensure measures at service provider's site enable normal operation in case of exceptional events such as disruption of communications with data center or malfunction for extended periods of time.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure measures are in place at the service provider's site to enable normal operation in case of exceptional events, such as the disruption of communications with the data center or malfunction for extended periods of time.

controls.title: No IT system access for foreign professional intermediaries
controls.description: When bank operates abroad through professional intermediary services (part of group), or representative offices/intermediaries/representatives of these offices, these individuals will not have access to its IT systems in Qatar.
controls.full_text: When the bank operates abroad through professional intermediary services (which are part of the group to which the establishment belongs), or when there are representative offices, intermediaries or representatives of these offices, these individuals will not have access to its IT systems in Qatar.
evidence_requirements: Access control policy preventing foreign intermediary access to Qatar IT systems

controls.title: Service provider implements equally stringent security policies
controls.description: Ensure service provider implements security policies, procedures and controls at least as stringent as bank would expect for its own operations.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that the service provider implements security policies, procedures and controls that are at least as stringent as it would expect for its own operations.
evidence_requirements: Service provider policy comparison against bank policies

controls.title: NIAP-aligned baseline in third-party service contracts and subcontractors
controls.description: Security controls and baseline policy specified in NIAP Manual included in third party service delivery agreement or contract; also applies to subcontractors used by third party.
controls.full_text: Security controls and baseline policy specified in the NIAP Manual are included in the third party service delivery agreement or contract. This shall also apply to subcontractors used by the third party.

controls.title: Pre-onboarding DC/technology provider due diligence
controls.description: Prior to onboarding data centre or technology provider, due diligence exercises to determine viability, capability, reliability, track record and financial position.
controls.full_text: Prior to onboarding of a data center or technology provider, due diligence exercises shall be carried out to determine its viability, capability, reliability, track record and financial position.

controls.title: Hosting physically located within Qatar
controls.description: Ensure all hosting of applications and data within data centre or application service providers physically located within the State of Qatar.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that all hosting of applications and data within data center or application service providers should be physically located within the State of Qatar.
evidence_requirements: DC location attestations confirming Qatar residency

controls.title: Change management and monitoring of 3P; service quality maintained
controls.description: Third party vendors and technology outsourcing companies subject to bank's change management and monitoring controls; quality and availability of banking services to end users and customers not negatively affected due to outsourcing.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that third party vendors and technology outsourcing companies are subject to the bank's change management and monitoring controls. Additionally, it must be further ensured that the quality and availability of banking services to end users and customers is not negatively affected due to the outsourcing arrangements.

controls.title: Multi-geography risk assessment and exit strategy
controls.description: Perform thorough risk assessment to formulate mitigating controls for service providers across multiple geographies; proactively evaluate risks in due diligence and develop mitigating controls and effective exit strategy; clarify data jurisdiction and applicable regulations at outset; review periodically and on significant changes.
controls.full_text: A thorough risk assessment must be performed to formulate mitigating controls for service providers across multiple geographies. Since banks are exposed to the jurisdiction of multiple geographies as a part of their outsourcing arrangements, the bank shall proactively evaluate such risks as part of its due diligence process and develop mitigating controls and, as required, an effective exit strategy. Additionally, the bank must clarify the jurisdiction for their data and applicable regulations at the outset of an outsourcing arrangement. This information shall be reviewed periodically and, in case of significant changes, performed by the service provider.

controls.title: Contracts not impede audits/inspections; QCB notification on access impediment
controls.description: Data centre and technology outsourcing contracts formulated and agreed in manner not obstructing/hindering bank or regulatory authorities to perform periodic audits/inspections/assessments; notify QCB as priority if access rights likely to be impeded.
controls.full_text: Data center and technology outsourcing contracts shall be formulated and agreed in a manner that does not obstruct or hinder the ability of the bank or regulatory authorities to perform periodic audits/inspections and assessments. The bank must notify QCB as a matter of priority in the event that the rights of access for the bank and/or the regulator are likely to be impeded.

controls.title: Subcontracting approval requirement (DC/tech)
controls.description: Outsourcing arrangement includes approval requirement for significant subcontracting of services and provisions by original technology service provider.
controls.full_text: The outsourcing arrangement must include an approval requirement for significant subcontracting of services and provisions by the original technology service provider.

controls.title: Outsourcing agreement requirements and conditions
controls.description: Requirements and conditions in data centre and technology outsourcing agreements include performance targets, service levels, availability, reliability, scalability, compliance, audit, security, contingency planning, disaster recovery capability and backup processing facilities.
controls.full_text: The requirements and conditions covered in the data center and technology outsourcing agreements shall include performance targets, service levels, availability, reliability, scalability, compliance, audit, security, contingency planning, disaster recovery capability and backup processing facilities.
evidence_requirements: Outsourcing agreements containing all listed requirements

controls.title: DR contingency framework with documented and tested plans
controls.description: Require service provider to develop and establish a disaster recovery contingency framework defining roles/responsibilities for documenting, maintaining and testing contingency plans and recovery procedures; bank must continue to operate normally in exceptional events.
controls.full_text: The bank shall require the service provider to develop and establish a disaster recovery contingency framework which defines its roles and responsibilities for documenting, maintaining and testing its contingency plans and recovery procedures. In addition to this, the bank must be able to continue to operate normally in case of exceptional events, such as the disruption of communications with the data center, or malfunction for extended periods of time.

controls.title: DR plan reviewed/updated/tested with exit and alternate options
controls.description: DR plan reviewed, updated and tested periodically per changing technology conditions and operational requirements; based on credible worst-case scenarios; incorporate viable alternatives for resuming IT operations elsewhere; include exit management plan and identification of additional/alternate technology service providers for support and services.
controls.full_text: The disaster recovery plan shall be reviewed, updated and tested periodically in accordance with changing technology conditions and operational requirements. The plan shall be based on credible worst case scenarios for service disruptions and must incorporate identification of viable alternatives for resuming its IT operations elsewhere; an exit management plan and identification of additional or alternate technology service providers for such support and services.

controls.title: Monitor/review provider's security; obtain periodic expert reports
controls.description: Ensure service provider implements security policies/procedures/controls at least as stringent as bank's own; monitor and review service provider security policies and controls periodically including obtaining periodic expert reports on security adequacy and compliance for operations and services provided.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that the service provider implements security policies, procedures and controls that are at least as stringent as it would expect for its own operations. Additionally, the bank shall monitor and review the security policies and controls of the service provider on a periodic basis, including obtaining periodic expert reports on security adequacy and compliance in respect of the operations and services provided by the service provider.

controls.title: Prior QCB approval before using service providers
controls.description: Bank seeking to use services of any service providers must seek prior approval of QCB before entering into any agreements.
controls.full_text: The bank, seeking to use the services of any service providers as stated above, must seek prior approval of the QCB before entering into any agreements for such services.
evidence_requirements: QCB pre-approval records for new service providers

controls.title: Policies/procedures/controls to prevent employee fraud
controls.description: Have policies, procedures and controls in place to prevent employees from committing fraud.
controls.full_text: The bank shall have policies, procedures and controls in place to prevent employees from committing fraud.

controls.title: Internal control framework with periodic review
controls.description: Internal control framework to prevent fraud; fraud risk mgmt team with business/operations/support groups periodic reviews of systems/controls to address gaps and strengthen the framework.
controls.full_text: The bank must have an internal control framework to prevent fraud. The fraud risk management team, along with the business/operations/support groups, periodic reviews of various systems and controls, shall address gaps, if any, to strengthen the internal control framework.

controls.title: Fraud review group of senior leaders meeting quarterly
controls.description: Fraud review group of senior leaders set up; meets at least quarterly to review fraud trends and preventive steps; reports to board of directors.
controls.full_text: A fraud review group comprising of senior leaders of the bank shall be set up at the bank. The group shall meet at least once a quarter to review fraud trends and preventive steps taken by the business group, and report the same to the board of directors.

controls.title: Fraud monitoring systems for suspicious transactions
controls.description: Fraud monitoring systems must be in place for monitoring suspicious transactions.
controls.full_text: Fraud monitoring systems must be in place for monitoring suspicious transactions.

controls.title: Card data segregation; card production separated from PIN generation
controls.description: To prevent fraudulent transactions through credit/debit card information, media containing valid account info, account numbers, PIN numbers, credit limits and account balances stored in area limited to only authorized personnel; production/issuing processes for cards kept physically separated from PIN generation and issuing environments.
controls.full_text: To prevent fraudulent transactions being made through credit/debit card information, the media containing valid account information, account numbers, PIN numbers, credit limits and account balances shall be stored in an area limited to only authorized personnel. Production and issuing processes for cards must be kept physically separated from the PIN generation and issuing environments.
evidence_requirements: Physical separation of card production and PIN generation

controls.title: Real-time fraud monitoring system for transactions
controls.description: Monitor transactions processed online, on ATM or POS terminals to deter fraudulent activity at merchant place or for money laundering detection; QCB requires real-time fraud monitoring system to detect suspicious activities on financial transactions.
controls.full_text: Monitoring of transactions processed online, on ATM or POS terminals shall be undertaken to deter any potential fraudulent activity happening at a merchant place, or for money laundering detection. The QCB requires that the bank must have a real-time fraud monitoring system running to detect suspicious activities on financial transactions.

controls.title: Velocity-check countermeasures on fraud alarms
controls.description: Counter-fraud measures in place to take action on fraudulent transactions after alarms raised; principles such as velocity checks enabled with reference to current and previous transactions at minimum.
controls.full_text: Measures to counter fraud must be in place for the bank to be able to take actions on any fraudulent transactions after alarms are raised by the systems. Principles, such as velocity checks, must be enabled with reference to current transactions and previous transactions, at a minimum.

controls.title: Reporting fraud attempts to MOI hotline and QCB
controls.description: Any fraud attempt on ATM/POS must be reported to MOI hotline per QCB instructions and QCB must be notified; embezzlement crimes (including attempted electronic embezzlement) reported; QCB notified for hacking, penetration, fake websites or forged credit cards; bank responsible for compliance of law and notifying related authorities.
controls.full_text: Any fraud attempt on ATM's or point of sales must be reported to the Ministry of Interior (MOI) hotline as stated in the QCB instructions, and the QCB must be notified. Embezzlement crimes must also be reported, including attempted embezzlement through electronic means. The QCB must be notified, in case of any hacking, penetration, fake websites or forged credit cards. However, the bank shall be responsible for compliance of law and notifying related authorities in this regard.

controls.title: Online authorization decision and tailored rule-based controls
controls.description: Fraud monitoring systems include online authorization decision process, possibilities to initiate queries and rule-based set of controls tailored to bank's needs and future fraud trends; coupled with existing payment acquiring system and part of fraud management system.
controls.full_text: Fraud monitoring systems shall include an online authorization decision process, possibilities to initiate queries and a rule-based set of controls that can be tailored to the need of the bank, as well as to cope with future fraud activities trends. This fraud monitoring system must be coupled with the existing payment acquiring system and be a part of the fraud management system which the bank is running.

controls.title: Fraud vulnerability assessment across channels
controls.description: Fraud Risk Management team performs fraud vulnerability assessments across all bank channels (branches, internet, ATM, phone banking, international branches if applicable); incorporate verification procedures at all channels to ensure only genuine transactions processed.
controls.full_text: Fraud vulnerability assessments shall be undertaken across the bank by the Fraud Risk Management team. These assessments shall cover all channels of the bank, such as branches, internet, ATM and phone banking, as well as international branches, if applicable. Appropriate verification procedures shall also be incorporated at all channels, such as phone banking, ATMs, branches and internet, to ensure that only genuine transactions are processed.

controls.title: Fraud analysis of new products/processes; mandated loss limits
controls.description: New products/processes analyzed for fraud vulnerabilities before being introduced; fraud loss limits mandated wherever vulnerabilities noticed.
controls.full_text: New products or processes shall be analyzed for fraud vulnerabilities before being introduced in the bank, and fraud loss limits shall be mandated wherever vulnerabilities are noticed.

controls.title: Fraud loss limits with review at 90% of limit
controls.description: All residual/open risks in products and processes covered by 'fraud loss' limits; monitored regularly by fraud risk management team; review undertaken with respective business group when fraud loss reaches 90 percent of limit set.
controls.full_text: All residual/open risks in products and processes must to be covered by setting 'fraud loss' limits. 'Fraud loss' limits must be monitored regularly by the fraud risk management team and a review needs to be undertaken with the respective business group when fraud loss amount reaches 90 percent of the limit set.

controls.title: Security measures for instrument delivery via couriers
controls.description: Incorporate security measures during delivery of instruments such as cards/cheque books/internet passwords to customers through couriers.
controls.full_text: Security measures shall be incorporated during delivery of instruments such as cards/cheque books/internet passwords to customers through couriers.

controls.title: Internet banking security features
controls.description: Internet banking systems have security features such as separate transaction passwords, two-factor authentication, multi-channel process for registering payees, upper limit on transaction value and SMS alerts to customers.
controls.full_text: Internet banking systems must have security features, such as separate transaction passwords, two-factor authentication, multi-channel process for registering payees, upper limit on transaction value and SMS alerts to customers.

controls.title: Access controls limiting info access to required employees
controls.description: Access controls and procedures ensure only employees required to know particular information have access to this and can validate the transactions.
controls.full_text: Appropriate access controls and procedures shall be in place to ensure that only employees who are required to know particular information have access to this and can validate the transactions.
evidence_requirements: Role-based access controls for transaction validation

controls.title: KYC and know-your-employee/vendor procedures
controls.description: Implement KYC for fraud prevention; strong procedures to carry out due diligence of potential customers, employees and vendors before they are enrolled.
controls.full_text: Know Your Customer (KYC) and know your employee/vendor procedures: The bank must ensure a KYC process is put in for fraud prevention. The bank shall implement strong procedures to carry out due diligence of potential customers, employees and vendors before they are enrolled.

controls.title: Dedicated physical security team
controls.description: All banks must have a dedicated team to take care of the security of the physical infrastructure.
controls.full_text: Physical security: All banks must have a dedicated team to take care of the security of the physical infrastructure.

controls.title: Fraud awareness among staff and customers
controls.description: Create awareness among staff and customers on fraud management and its policies on regular basis.
controls.full_text: Creation of fraud awareness amongst staff and customers: The bank must create awareness amongst staff and customers on fraud management and its policies on a regular basis.

controls.title: Strong internal control framework with continuous review
controls.description: Put strong internal control framework in place; fraud risk management team with business/operations/support groups continuously review systems and controls to remove gaps and strengthen the framework.
controls.full_text: Fraud prevention practices: A strong internal control framework shall be put in place by the bank. The fraud risk management team along with the business/operations/support groups, should continuously review the various systems and controls, to remove gaps, if any, and to strengthen the internal control framework.

controls.title: Channels for fraud reporting and detailed investigation
controls.description: Proper channels for reporting of fraud: system triggers for exceptional transactions, channels for customer/employee alerts/disputes, seeding/mystery shopping exercises, encouraging employees/customers/well-wishers to report suspicious transactions/behavior; exceptional/suspicious transactions/activities investigated in detail.
controls.full_text: The bank must have proper channels for the reporting of fraud. System triggers that throw up exceptional transactions and channels that take note of customer/employee alerts/disputes, seeding/mystery shopping exercises and encouraging employees/customers/well-wishers to report suspicious transactions/behavior, are some of the techniques that must be used for detection of fraud. The exceptional/suspicious transactions/activities reported through these mechanisms must be investigated in detail.

controls.title: Mechanisms for dispute/exception/suspicion reporting; whistle-blower mechanism
controls.description: Mechanisms established to report disputes/exceptions or suspicions highlighted by stakeholders including transaction monitoring teams; investigate thoroughly; have well-publicized whistle blowing mechanism.
controls.full_text: Appropriate mechanisms must be established at the bank, to report disputes/exceptions or suspicions highlighted by various stakeholders, including transaction monitoring teams in the bank and to investigate them thoroughly. The bank must have a well-publicized whistle blowing mechanism.

controls.title: Dedicated email ID and phone for fraud reporting
controls.description: Dedicated email ID and phone number for customers to report fraudulent activities; dedicated team to reply through emails; phone banking officers and branch staff trained on responses to customer fraud queries/concerns.
controls.full_text: Dedicated email ID and phone number for reporting suspected frauds: The bank must have a dedicated email ID and phone number for customers to report any fraudulent activities. A dedicated team must be created to reply to customer queries and concerns through the above email IDs. Phone banking officers and branch staff must also be trained on responses to customers' queries and concerns on fraud.
evidence_requirements: Dedicated fraud reporting email and phone
Training records for phone banking/branch staff

controls.title: Continuous training of fraud risk management team
controls.description: Fraud risk management team must undergo continuous training to enhance skills and competencies.
controls.full_text: The fraud risk management team must undergo continuous training to enhance its skills and competencies.
evidence_requirements: Continuous training records for fraud team

controls.title: Report sharing and closure tracking
controls.description: Investigating team shares report with relevant authority within bank or tracks down to closure.
controls.full_text: The investigating team must share the report with the relevant authority within the bank or track it down to closure.

controls.title: Computer forensics and large-volume data analysis tools
controls.description: Adopt advanced techniques and skills towards computer forensics, forensic accounting and tools to analyze large volumes of data based on current risk appetite.
controls.full_text: The bank must adopt various advanced techniques and skills towards computer forensics, forensic accounting and tools to analyze large volumes of data, based on their current risk appetite.

controls.title: Report merchant acquiring fraud to QCB
controls.description: Any frauds in merchant acquiring business shall be reported to the QCB.
controls.full_text: Any frauds in merchant acquiring business shall be reported to the QCB.
evidence_requirements: Merchant acquiring fraud reports to QCB

controls.title: Acquirer reports ATM acquiring frauds; assists issuing bank in recovery
controls.description: Frauds in ATM acquiring business: in shared ATM network the acquirer must report the fraud and not the issuer of the ATM cards; acquiring bank shall solicit help of issuing bank in money recovery.
controls.full_text: Frauds in ATM acquiring business: In a shared ATM network, the acquirer must report the fraud and not the issuer of the ATM cards. The acquiring bank shall solicit the help of the issuing bank in the recovery of the money.
evidence_requirements: Recovery cooperation records with issuer banks

controls.title: Share data with police even when not victim
controls.description: Share data and documents requested by the police, even in cases where the bank is not victim of the fraud but has been in receipt of fraudulent money into its accounts.
controls.full_text: The bank must share data and documents requested by the police, even in cases where the bank in question is not the victim of the fraud, but has been in receipt of fraudulent money into its accounts.

controls.title: Continuous fraud risk awareness to customers
controls.description: Aim to continuously provide fraud risk awareness to customers for their own protection.
controls.full_text: The bank must aim to continuously provide fraud risk awareness to its customers for their own protection.

controls.title: Fraud prevention training across forums
controls.description: Bank conducts training on fraud prevention practices at various forums; undertaken by fraud management team.
controls.full_text: The bank must conduct training on fraud prevention practices at various forums and this must be undertaken by the fraud management team.

controls.title: Board/senior management consumer education commitment
controls.description: Board of directors/senior management commit towards consumer education initiatives by providing adequate resources, improving customer education measures on ongoing process.
controls.full_text: The board of directors/senior management must commit towards consumer education initiatives by providing adequate resources, improving customer education measures on an ongoing process.
evidence_requirements: Board/senior management approved consumer education plan and budget

controls.title: Customer cyber security awareness and phishing reporting
controls.description: Improve and maintain customer awareness and education with regard to cyber security risks; encourage customers to report phishing emails/sites and take effective remedial action over reports.
controls.full_text: The bank shall improve and maintain customer awareness and education with regard to cyber security risks. The bank shall encourage customers to report phishing emails/phishing sites and take effective remedial action over such reports.

controls.title: Ongoing customer awareness activities
controls.description: Undertake awareness activities on ongoing basis using variety of delivery methods including: improving and maintaining customer awareness/education on cyber security risks; encouraging customers to report phishing mails/sites and take effective remedial action; educating customers on risks of sharing login credentials/passwords.
controls.full_text: The bank must undertake awareness activities that shall be conducted on an ongoing basis, using a variety of delivery methods in addition to: Improving and maintaining customer awareness and education with regard to cyber security risks. Encouraging customers to report phishing mails/phishing sites, and take effective remedial action on these reports. Educating the customers on the risks of sharing their login credentials/passwords etc.

controls.title: Security strategy for data and systems C-I-A
controls.description: Have security strategy to ensure confidentiality, integrity and availability of data and systems.
controls.full_text: The bank must have a security strategy to ensure confidentiality, integrity and availability of its data and systems.
evidence_requirements: Security strategy document with C-I-A goals

controls.title: Evaluation of internet system security and encryption algorithms
controls.description: Evaluate security requirements of internet systems; adopt encryption algorithms which are well-established international standards subjected to rigorous scrutiny by international community of cryptographers or approved by authoritative professional bodies or government agencies.
controls.full_text: The bank must evaluate the security requirements associated with its internet systems and adopt encryption algorithms, which are of well-established international standards and subjected to rigorous scrutiny by an international community of cryptographers or approved by an authoritative professional bodies, or government agencies.

controls.title: Two-factor transaction-signing for internet/online banking
controls.description: Implement two-factor authentication for transaction-signing for authorizing internet/online banking transactions.
controls.full_text: The bank must implement two-factor authentication for transaction-signing for authorizing internet/ online banking transactions.

controls.title: Token-based controls for institutional/accredited/corporate transactions
controls.description: Implement controls to authorize transactions with institutional investors, accredited investors or corporate entities; perform risk assessment on such systems and use token-based mechanisms to authorize transactions.
controls.full_text: Controls shall be implemented to authorize transactions with institutional investors, accredited investors or corporate entities. The bank must perform a risk assessment on such systems and use token-based mechanisms to authorize transactions.

controls.title: Assurance to customers of authenticated online sessions
controls.description: Provide customers and users of internet services assurance that online login access and transactions performed over the internet on bank website are protected and authenticated.
controls.full_text: The bank shall provide customers and users of its internet services an assurance that online login access and transactions performed over the internet on the bank website are protected and authenticated.
evidence_requirements: Customer assurance communications (EV cert, padlock, MFA)

controls.title: Physical and logical access controls; processing/transmission integrity
controls.description: Implement physical and logical access controls allowing only authorized staff to access systems; implement appropriate processing and transmission controls to protect integrity of systems and data.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement physical and logical access controls to allow only authorized staff to access its systems. The bank shall also implement appropriate processing and transmission controls to protect the integrity of systems and data.
evidence_requirements: Integrity controls for processing and transmission

controls.title: Monitoring of abnormal activities/errors/unusual transactions
controls.description: Implement monitoring system to alert to abnormal system activities, transmission errors or unusual online transactions; develop action plan to verify and close issues/errors.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement a monitoring system to alert to any abnormal system activities, transmission errors or unusual online transactions. The bank shall develop an action plan to verify and close these issues or errors.
evidence_requirements: Action plan workflow for issue closure

controls.title: VA/PT of online banking against MITMA, browser, app attacks
controls.description: Undertake VA and PT of online banking system to minimize exposure to MITMA (man-in-the-middle), man-in-the-browser or man-in-the-application attacks.
controls.full_text: The bank shall undertake a vulnerability assessment and penetration testing of its online banking system to minimize exposure to other forms of cyber attacks such as man-in-the-middle attack (MITMA), man-in-the browser attack or man-in-the application attack.
evidence_requirements: Online banking VA/PT reports including MITM/MITB scenarios

controls.title: High resiliency and capacity guarding against DoS/DDoS
controls.description: Maintain high resiliency and availability of online systems and supporting systems (interface systems, backend host systems, network equipment); put measures to plan and track capacity utilization and guard against online attacks including DoS and DDoS.
controls.full_text: The bank shall maintain high resiliency and availability of online systems and supporting systems (such as interface systems, backend host systems and network equipment). The bank must put in place measures to plan and track capacity utilization as well as guard against online attacks. These online attacks include DoS attack and DDoS attack.

controls.title: Security measures for mobile online services and payments
controls.description: Implement security measures for mobile online services and payments.
controls.full_text: The bank must implement security measures for mobile online services and payments.
controls.category: Mobile online services and payment security

controls.title: Mobile risk assessment and payment card fraud countermeasures
controls.description: Conduct risk assessment to identify possible fraud scenarios; put appropriate measures to counteract payment card fraud via mobile devices.
controls.full_text: The bank must conduct a risk assessment to identify possible fraud scenarios and put in place appropriate measures to counteract payment card fraud via mobile devices.
controls.category: Mobile online services and payment security

controls.title: Adequate protection of mobile sensitive data
controls.description: Ensure adequate protection of sensitive or confidential information used for mobile online services and payments.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that there is adequate protection of sensitive or confidential information used for mobile online services and payments.
controls.category: Mobile online services and payment security
evidence_requirements: Mobile app data protection controls (encryption, secure storage)

controls.title: Educate customers on protecting mobile devices
controls.description: Educate customers on security measures to protect their own mobile devices from viruses and other errant software causing malicious damage.
controls.full_text: The bank must educate its customers on security measures to protect their own mobile devices from viruses and other errant software which may cause malicious damage and have harmful consequences.
controls.category: Mobile online services and payment security

controls.title: 3D Secure for all card issuers
controls.description: At minimum 3D Secure (provided by major payment card brands) shall be implemented by all card issuers for cardholder authentication; customers informed about authentication procedure and enrolled through dedicated process with the bank.
controls.full_text: At a minimum, 3D Secure, provided by the major payment card brands, shall be implemented by all card issuers for cardholder authentication. Customers shall be informed about the authentication procedure and enrolled through a dedicated process with the bank.
controls.category: Mobile online services and payment security

controls.title: Compliance with PCI-DSS, PA-DSS, OWASP, PCI-PTS, PCI-PIN
controls.description: Comply with international security standards and best practices including PCI-DSS, PCI Payment Application Data Security (PA-DSS), OWASP, PCI PIN Transaction Security (PCIPTS) and PCI-PIN Entry Device Security.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that they are compliant with international security standards / methodologies and best practices such as the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS), PCI Payment Application Data Security (PA-DSS), OWASP, PCI PIN Transaction Security (PCIPTS and PCI-PIN Entry Device Security.

controls.title: Annual PCI compliance reporting to QCB
controls.description: Report compliance of these standards to QCB annually.
controls.full_text: The bank must report the compliance of these standards to the QCB annually.
evidence_requirements: Annual PCI standards compliance report to QCB

controls.title: Secure chips (EMV) and strong card auth (DDA/CDA)
controls.description: Deploy secure chips (EMV compliant) to store sensitive payment card data; payment terminal used must be EMV compliant; implement strong card authentication methods such as Dynamic Data Authentication (DDA) or Combined Data Authentication (CDA) for online and offline card transactions.
controls.full_text: The bank must deploy secure chips (EMV compliant) to store sensitive payment card data. The payment terminal used must be EMV complaint. The bank must also implement strong card authentication methods such as dynamic data authentication (DDA) or combined data authentication ("CDA") methods for online and offline card transactions.
evidence_requirements: EMV chip card and terminal evidence

controls.title: Magnetic stripe protection
controls.description: Ensure that magnetic stripes are protected.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that magnetic stripes are protected.

controls.title: Online ATM authorization with issuer-performed PIN auth
controls.description: For ATM card transactions allow only online transaction authorization; authentication of customer sensitive static information such as PINs must be performed by card issuer, not third party payment processing service provider; regular security reviews of infrastructure and processes used by service providers.
controls.full_text: For transactions that customers perform with their ATM cards, the bank must only allow online transaction authorization. The authentication of customers' sensitive static information, such as PINs, must be performed by the card issuer, and not a third party payment processing service provider. The bank must perform regular security reviews of the infrastructure and processes being used by its service providers.

controls.title: Security controls on payment card systems and networks
controls.description: Ensure security controls implemented at payment card systems and networks.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that security controls are implemented at payment card systems and networks.

controls.title: Activate new mailed cards only upon customer instruction
controls.description: Only activate new payment cards sent to customer via post upon obtaining customer's instruction.
controls.full_text: The bank must only activate new payment cards sent to a customer via post upon obtaining the customer's instruction.
evidence_requirements: Card activation workflow requiring customer instruction

controls.title: OTP-based 2FA for CNP internet transactions
controls.description: Implement two-factor authentication such as OTP for Card Not Present (CNP) transactions via internet to reduce fraud risk.
controls.full_text: The bank must implement two factor authentication such as one-time-password (OTP) for CNP transactions via internet to reduce fraud risk associated with CNP.

controls.title: Cardholder transaction alerts on customer-defined thresholds
controls.description: Promptly notify cardholders via transaction alerts when withdrawals/charges exceeding customer-defined thresholds are made on customer's payment cards; include source and amount of transaction in the alert.
controls.full_text: To enhance card payment security, the bank must promptly notify cardholders via transaction alerts when withdrawals/charges exceeding customer-defined thresholds are made on the customers' payment cards. The bank must include in the transaction alert, information such as the source and amount of the transaction.
evidence_requirements: Cardholder alerting configuration with thresholds, source and amount

controls.title: Robust fraud detection with behavioral scoring
controls.description: Implement robust fraud detection systems with behavioral scoring or equivalent and correlation capabilities to identify and curb fraudulent activities.
controls.full_text: The bank shall implement robust fraud detection systems with behavioral scoring or equivalent; and correlation capabilities to identify and curb fraudulent activities.

controls.title: Follow-up on deviant card behavior with cardholder authorization
controls.description: Follow up on transactions exhibiting behavior deviating significantly from cardholder's usual card usage patterns; investigate and obtain cardholder authorization prior to completing transaction.
controls.full_text: The bank shall follow up on transactions exhibiting behavior which deviates significantly from a cardholder's usual card usage patterns, and shall investigate these transactions and obtain the cardholder's authorization prior to completing the transaction.
evidence_requirements: Cardholder authorization workflow for anomalous transactions

controls.title: ATM/payment kiosk countermeasures
controls.description: Counteract fraudsters' attacks on ATMs and payment kiosks by: anti-skimming solutions detecting foreign devices over/near card entry slot; detection mechanisms and alerts to staff for follow-up; tamper-resistant keypads ensuring customer PINs encrypted during transmission with encrypting PIN pad supporting at least TDES or AES; shoulder-surfing prevention; CCTV with quality footage; camera covering ATM surrounding space at angle >=70 degrees; screen position avoiding easy reading; wide-angle pinhole camera; motion-detection camera not covering keypad; external lighting >=LUX50; camera sensitivity >=0.5 LUX and resolution >=3 megapixels; video recording retention per QCB instructions; inclined screen displays and side view protection plus keypad typing cover protection; ATM alarms detecting unusual events; third-party ATM internal access covered by agreements including ICT access agreement; maintenance access with bank's authorized personnel (remote ATMs may use security-dedicated third party with vendor); access to ATM data center by third party strictly authorized only when accompanied by bank's authorized personnel; vendors never left alone at bank premises with logged/monitored access.
controls.full_text: The bank must consider putting the following measures in place to counteract fraudsters' attacks on ATMs and payment kiosks: Install anti-skimming solutions on these machines and kiosks to detect the presence of foreign devices placed over or near a card entry slot. Install detection mechanisms and send alerts to appropriate staff at the bank for follow-up response and action. Implement tamper-resistant keypads to ensure that customer' PINs are encrypted during transmission; also when typing the PIN information, the data must be encrypted, so the keypad must be an encrypting PIN pad, supporting at least TDES (Triple DES) or AES. Implement appropriate measures to prevent shoulder surfing of customer PINs. Conduct video surveillance of activities at ATM machines and payment kiosks, and maintain the quality of CCTV footage. A camera must be installed to cover the ATMs surrounding space with angle not less than 70 degrees. ATM screen position: The position of screen must avoid easy reading to protect it against shoulder surfing. Pinhole camera installed be a wide angle camera. Camera has to be connected to motion detection device and must not cover the keypad entry by customers. External lighting of the covered space not be less than LUX50. Camera sensitivity must be not less than 0.5 LUX and resolution shall be at least 3 mega pixels. Video recording capacity cover retention period mentioned in the latest instructions issued by the QCB. Screen displays must be inclined and side view protection exist in addition to installing keypad typing cover protection in order to avoid shoulder surfing that could lead to personal information stealing. ATM alarms must be configured to detect unusual events. Access to the inner section of the ATM by third parties must be covered by agreements, including a third party ICT access agreement. Access to inner section of the ATM for maintenance must be done in conjunction with bank's authorized personnel. Access to remote ATMs for maintenance can be organized with a security dedicated third party company and the vendor. Access to the ATM data center by third party vendor must be strictly authorized only if accompanied with bank's authorized personnel. Vendors must never be left alone in bank's premises, especially when working on bank's systems. This type of access must be logged and monitored as per the requirements given in this chapter.
evidence_requirements: ATM CCTV specs (angle, LUX, resolution, retention)

controls.title: Customer ATM awareness messages
controls.description: Communicate awareness messages to customers regularly on ATM risks: checking abnormal fixtures, checking card slot before insertion, checking ATM sides for added fixtures (fake advertisement boxes that could be cameras/data-capturing devices).
controls.full_text: The bank must also ensure awareness messages are communicated to customers on a regular basis towards risk such as: Checking if something abnormal has been fixed on the ATM. Checking the card slot before inserting a payment card. Checking the sides of the ATM to verify if any fixture has been added, such as a fake advertisement box that could be used as a container for cameras or other data-capturing devices.

controls.title: POS contract clause prohibiting card data retention by merchants
controls.description: For POS terminals state clearly in contract that merchants are not allowed to swipe the card data and keep it stored in clear text as it can lead to theft of data.
controls.full_text: For point of sale terminals the bank must state clearly in the contract that merchants are not allowed to swipe the card data and to keep it stored in clear text as it can lead to theft of data.
evidence_requirements: Merchant POS contract clauses prohibiting cleartext card data retention

controls.title: POS terminals compliant with PCI-PED/PTS and PIN security
controls.description: POS terminals comply with best practices and standards (PCIPED/PTS, PIN security): protect customers against shoulder surfing with means to hide keypad while keying PIN; encrypt data end-to-end to terminal and acquirer for PIN entry/processing/validation, payment validation and printing; tamper proof/evident/responsive; support at least TDES, AES or better encryption.
controls.full_text: POS terminals must comply with best practices and standards such as: PCIPED/PTS and PIN security requirements. Terminals must: Protect customers against shoulder surfing. Terminals have means to hide the keypad while keying the PIN code. Encrypt the data all along the way to the terminal and then to the acquirer, for PIN entry, PIN processing and validation, payment validation and printing. Be tamper proof, evident and responsive. Must support at least TDES, AES or better encryption.

controls.title: No card details on sales/payment receipts; encoded data on receipts
controls.description: Sales or payment receipts must not disclose credit card details; encoding the data must be a common practice on merchant and customer receipts.
controls.full_text: Sales or payment receipts must not disclose the credit card details and encoding the data must be a common practice on merchant and customer receipts.
evidence_requirements: Receipt template review evidencing PAN masking/encoding

controls.title: Secure storage of sensitive cheque information
controls.description: Sensitive information on cheque such as personal account numbers, account holder's name and signature must be kept in secure area.
controls.full_text: Sensitive information on cheque, such as personal account numbers, account holder's name and signature, must be kept in a secure area.

controls.title: Cryptographic protection of digitally signed cheques
controls.description: If cheques are digitally signed, data must be secured by cryptographic techniques as defined in the cryptographic section.
controls.full_text: If the cheque are digitally signed, the data must be secured by cryptographic techniques, as defined in the cryptographic section.
evidence_requirements: Digital signing crypto configuration for cheques

controls.title: KYC-aligned customer identification for cheque handling
controls.description: Measures for identifying customers in line with best practices such as KYC; bank maintains same level of controls when identifying and registering new customers.
controls.full_text: Measures for identifying customers must be in line with best practices, such as KYC, and the bank must maintain the same level of controls when identifying and registering new customers.
evidence_requirements: KYC procedures applied to cheque operations

controls.title: Core banking server reliability and resilience
controls.description: Core banking servers and infrastructure shall be reliable and resilient; implementation and management of core banking services done per network management guidelines.
controls.full_text: Core banking servers and infrastructure shall be reliable and resilient. Implementation and management of core banking services to be done in line with network management guidelines.
evidence_requirements: Core banking architecture design with HA/resilience

controls.title: Secure core banking applications and databases
controls.description: Core banking applications and databases secured per software security and data security guidelines.
controls.full_text: Core banking applications and databases shall be secured, as per software security and data security guidelines.

controls.title: VA/PT of core banking linked applications and database
controls.description: VA and PT of set of applications linked to core banking applications and database performed per vulnerability assessment and penetration testing guidelines.
controls.full_text: VA and PT of set of applications linked to the core banking applications and database shall be performed as per vulnerability assessment and penetration testing guidelines.

controls.title: Cryptographic and key management adherence for core banking
controls.description: Core banking systems must adhere to the cryptographic and key management guidelines.
controls.full_text: Core banking systems must adhere to the cryptographic and key management guidelines.
evidence_requirements: Crypto and key management evidence for core banking

controls.title: Core banking resilience, compliance/event archiving, integrity controls, encryption and RBAC
controls.description: Ensure core banking system: resilient through specific/business continuity mechanisms at business and technical levels; policy ensuring compliance, security requirements and security events exists with archiving for subsequent analysis and Qatar data retention compliance; integrity control processes on main data in core database with versioning system for app changes; core info hidden from unauthorized access through secure mode such as encryption methods and layered infrastructure with sensitive info encrypted using latest encryption standards; authentication mechanisms ensuring authorized clearly identified personnel access sensitive info using RBAC principles internally.
controls.full_text: The bank must ensure that: The core banking system is resilient through specific/business continuity mechanisms at business and technical levels. A policy to ensure compliance, security requirements and security events exists. Archiving of such events is a must for subsequent analysis and complying with the legal requirements for data retention in Qatar, as well as the requirements mentioned in this document. Integrity control processes are implemented on the main data residing in the core database, as well as versioning system for the application changes. It is a must that the core information is hidden from unauthorized access through a secure mode such as encryption methods and layered infrastructure. The core banking application database sensitive information records must be protected by using latest encryption standards. The bank must use authentication mechanisms that will ensure that authorized and clearly identified personnel have access to sensitive information, using RBAC principles internally.
evidence_requirements: Compliance/event archival policy with Qatar retention
Layered encryption and RBAC for sensitive core data
